hypothesis: Kama jimbo linalopokea kila kitu, Florida ilipatia Romney wajumbe wake wote hamsini, na kumsukuma mbele kama mgombea wa kwanza kwa uteuzi wa Chama cha Republican.

source: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

source: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

hypothesis: Katika Berlin, polisi waliripoti watu 6,500 waliokuwa wakifanya maandamano.

source: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

source: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.
reference: Mwezi uliopita, kulikuwa na maandamano makubwa huko Poland wakati nchi hiyo ilisaini Mkataba wa Kupambana na Biashara za Bidhaa Bandia, ambao umesababisha serikali ya Polandi kuamua kutoidhinisha makubaliano hayo, kwa sasa.

source: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

hypothesis: Latvia na Slovakia zote zimechelewesha mchakato wa kujiunga na ACTA.

source: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

source: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

source: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

source: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.
reference: Wiki iliyopita, Naked News ilitangaza kuwa wangeongeza sana idhini yake ya utangazaji wa Habari kwa lugha za kimataifa, na watangazaji watatu wapya.
hypothesis: Wiki iliyopita, Naked News ilitangaza kwamba itaongeza sana mamlaka yake ya lugha ya kimataifa kwa taarifa za habari, na matangazo matatu mapya.

source: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.
reference: Tayari likiripoti kwa Kiingereza na Kijapani, shirika la kimataifa linazindua mipango ya lugha za Kihispania, Kiitaliano, na Kikorea, kwa televisheni, wavuti, na vifaa vya mkononi.
hypothesis: Tayari shirika hilo la kimataifa linatoa ripoti katika Kiingereza na Kijapani, na sasa linatangaza programu za lugha ya Kihispania, Kiitaliano, na Kikorea, kwa ajili ya televisheni, Intaneti, na vifaa vya simu.

source: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.
reference: "Kwa bahati nzuri hakuna klichofanyika kwangu, lakini niliona jambo la kutisha sana, watu walipokuwa wakijaribu kuvunja madirisha ili watoke nje.
hypothesis: "Kwa bahati nzuri hakuna kilichonipata, lakini niliona mandhari mbaya sana, watu wakijaribu kuvunja madirisha ili watoke.

source: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.
reference: Watu walikuwa wakigonga vioo kwa viti, lakini madirisha hayangevunjika.
hypothesis: Watu walikuwa wakipiga vioo kwa viti, lakini madirisha hayakuvunjika.

source: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.
reference: Kimojawapo cha vioo kilivunjika hatimaye, na wakaanza kutoka nje kupitia dirishani," alisema manusura Franciszek Kowal.
hypothesis: Hatimaye, kioo kimoja kilivunjika, nao wakaanza kutoka nje kupitia dirisha", akasema Franciszek Kowal, aliyeokoka.

source: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.
reference: Nyota hutoa mwangaza na joto kwa sababu ya nishati inayotengenezwa wakati atomu za hidrojeni zinapochanganywa (au kuunganishwa) pamoja ili kuunda elementi nzito.
hypothesis: Nyota hutoa nuru na joto kwa sababu ya nishati inayotokezwa wakati atomu za hidrojeni zinapounganishwa (au kuunganishwa) pamoja ili kutokeza elementi nzito zaidi.

source: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.
reference: Wanasayansi wanashugulika kuunda tanuri la kinyuklia ambalo linaweza kutengeneza nishati kwa njia hiyo hiyo.
hypothesis: Wanasayansi wanafanya kazi ya kutengeneza mtambo wa kugeuza umeme kwa njia hiyohiyo.

source: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.
reference: Hii, hata hivyo, ni shida ngumu sana kutatua na itachukua miaka mingi kabla ya matanuri ya kufaa ya kinyuklia kuundwa.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, hili ni tatizo gumu sana kutatua na itachukua miaka mingi kabla ya kuona vipokezi vya fuzi vinavyotumika vikijengwa.

source: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.
reference: Sindano ya chuma cha pua huelea juu ya maji kwa sababu ya mvuto kwenye uso.
hypothesis: Sindano la chuma huelea juu ya maji kwa sababu ya mkazo wa uso.

source: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.
reference: Nguvu za mvuto kwenye sura hutokea kwa sababu molekyuli za maji katika sura ya maji huvutana kwa nguvu zenyewe kwa zenyewe kuliko jinsi zinavyovutwa na molekyuli za hewa zilizo juu yake.
hypothesis: Mvutano wa uso hutokea kwa sababu molekuli za maji kwenye uso wa maji huvutwa kwa nguvu zaidi kwa kila mmoja kuliko ilivyo kwa molekuli za hewa juu yao.

source: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.
reference: Molekuli za maji hutengeneza ngozi isiyoonekana katika uso wa maji ambayo huwezesha vitu kama sindano kuelea juu ya maji.
hypothesis: Molekuli za maji hufanya ngozi isiyoonekana juu ya uso wa maji ambayo inaruhusu vitu kama sindano kuelea juu ya maji.

source: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.
reference: Ukengele katika kibao cha kisasa cha kutelezea una ncha mbili zenye uwazi uliobonyea katikati yao. Ncha hizo mbili huruhusu kushikilia vizuri kwa barafu, hata wakati imebenuliwa.
hypothesis: Upande wa sketi ya kisasa ya barafu una makali mawili na shimo la concave kati yao.

source: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.
reference: Kwa sababu ukengele umepindika kidogo upande wa chini, jinsi ukengele unavyoelekea upande mmoja au mwingine, ncha ambayo inaambatana na barafu pia inajipinda.
hypothesis: Kwa kuwa sehemu ya chini ya blade imeinama kidogo, wakati blade inapoelekea upande mmoja au mwingine, makali ambayo yanagusa barafu pia huinama.

source: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.
reference: Hii husababisha mtelezaji kugeuka. Ikiwa vitelezi vitageuka kulia, mtelezaji anageuka kulia, ikiwa vitelezi vitageuka kushoto, mtelezaji anageuka kushoto.
hypothesis: Hii husababisha skater kugeuka. Kama skates huelekeza kulia, skater huelekeza kulia, kama skates huelekeza kushoto, skater huelekeza kushoto.

source: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.
reference: Ili kurejea katika hali yao ya awali ya nishati, ni lazima ziondoe nishati ya ziada zilizopata kutoka kwa mwangaza.
hypothesis: Ili warudi kwenye kiwango chao cha awali cha nishati, ni lazima waondoe nishati ya ziada waliyopata kutokana na nuru.

source: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".
reference: Hufanya hivi kwa kutoa chembe ndogo ya mwanga inayoitwa “fotoni”.
hypothesis: Wao hufanya hivyo kwa kutoa chembe ndogo ya nuru iitwayo "photon".

source: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.
reference: Wanasayansi huita mchakato huu "utoaji wa mionzi uliosisimuliwa" kwani atomu husisimuliwa na mwanga mkali, na kusababisha utoaji wa fotoni ya mwanga, na mwanga ni aina ya mionzi.
hypothesis: Wanasayansi huita mchakato huo "mwanga unaotokezwa kwa kuchochea" kwa sababu atomu huchochewa na nuru yenye kung'aa, na kusababisha kutokezwa kwa fotoni ya nuru, nayo nuru ni aina ya miale.

source: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.
reference: Picha inayofuata inaonyesha atomu zikitoa fotoni. Kwa hakika, katika hali halisi fotoni ni ndogo zaidi kuliko zile zilizo kwenye picha.
hypothesis: Picha inayofuata inaonyesha atomu kutoa fotoni. Bila shaka, katika hali halisi fotoni ni ndogo sana kuliko zile katika picha.

source: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!
reference: Fotoni ni ndogo hata kuliko vitu vinavyotengeneza atomu!
hypothesis: Foti ni ndogo hata kuliko vitu vinavyotokeza atomu!

source: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.
reference: Baada ya mamia ya saa za operesheni, hatimaye uzi wa balbu unaungua na balbu ya nuru haiwezi kufanya kazi tena.
hypothesis: Baada ya mamia ya saa za kufanya kazi, hatimaye utambi wa balbu hiyo huungua na balbu hiyo haiwezi tena kufanya kazi.

source: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.
reference: Balbu ya mwanga basi inahitaji kubadilishwa. Ni muhimu kuwa na uangalifu wakati wa kuibadilisha balbu ya mwanga.
hypothesis: Kisha, ni lazima tochiwe, na ni lazima tochiwe kwa uangalifu.

source: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.
reference: Kwanza, swichi ya taa nyepesi inahitaji kuzimwa au waya kutengwa.
hypothesis: Kwanza, ni lazima ufungue kifaa cha taa au kukatisha kebo.

source: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.
reference: Hii ni kwa sababu umeme unaopita ndani ya soketi ambamo sehemu ya metali ya balbu hukaa unaweza kukupa mshtuko mkubwa wa umeme ukikugusa sehemu ya ndani ya soketi ama sehemu ya metali ya balbu ikiwa bado ina sehemu iliyobakia kwenye tundu.
hypothesis: Hii ni kwa sababu umeme unaopenya kwenye soketi ambamo sehemu ya chuma ya balbu iko unaweza kukupa mshtuko mkubwa wa umeme ikiwa utagusa sehemu ya ndani ya soketi au msingi wa chuma wa balbu wakati bado sehemu fulani iko katika soketi.

source: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.
reference: Kiungo kikuu cha mfumo wa mzunguko ni moyo, ambao hupiga damu.
hypothesis: Chombo kikuu cha mfumo wa mzunguko wa damu ni moyo, ambao hupompa damu.

source: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.
reference: Damu inatoka moyoni katika mirija inayoitwa ateri na inarudi moyoni katika mirija inayoitwa vena. Mirija midogo kabisa huitwa kapilari.
hypothesis: Damu hutoka moyoni kupitia njia inayoitwa mishipa na kurudi moyoni kupitia njia inayoitwa mishipa ya damu.

source: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.
reference: Meno ya triseratopu yangeweza kuponda si majani pekee, bali pia matawi na mizizi migumu sana.
hypothesis: Meno ya triceratops yangeweza kuangamiza si majani tu bali hata matawi na mizizi migumu sana.

source: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.
reference: Baadhi ya wanasayansi wanadhani kwamba Triseratopu walikula sikadi, ambazo ni aina ya mmea uliokuwa wa kawaida katika Kretasea.
hypothesis: Wanasayansi fulani wanaamini kwamba Triceratops walikula mimea ya aina ya cycads, ambayo ilikuwa ya kawaida katika kipindi cha Mchanga.

source: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.
reference: Mimea hii inaonekana kama mtende mdogo wenye taji ya majani yenye ncha kali, yenye miiba.
hypothesis: Mimea hiyo hufanana na mtende mdogo wenye taji lenye majani makali yenye miiba.

source: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.
reference: Triseratops angeutumia mdomo wake wenye nguvu kuyatoa majani kabla ya kula shina.
hypothesis: Huenda Triceratops alitumia mdomo wake wenye nguvu kuondoa majani kabla ya kula shina.

source: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.
reference: Wanasayansi wengine wanadai kuwa mimea hii ina sumu kali na kwa hiyo hakuna uwezekano kuwa dinosaria yeyote aliila, ingawa leo hii wavivu na wanyama wengine kama kasuku (kizazi cha dinosaria) wanaweza kula majani au matunda ya sumu.
hypothesis: Wanasayansi wengine husema kwamba mimea hiyo ni yenye sumu sana kwa hiyo haiwezekani kwamba dinosauri yoyote ilikula mimea hiyo, ingawa leo mnyama - mvivu na wanyama wengine kama papa (mzao wa dinosauri) wanaweza kula majani au matunda yenye sumu.

source: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.
reference: Mvuto wa lo ungewezaje kunivuta? Kama ungesimama katika uso wa lo, ungekuwa na uzani mdogo kuliko ulionao duniani.
hypothesis: Kama wewe kusimama juu ya uso wa Io, wewe itakuwa uzito chini kuliko wewe kufanya duniani.

source: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.
reference: Mtu aliye na uzito wa pauni 200 (kilogramu 90) duniani anaweza kuwa na uzito wa pauni 36 (kilogramu 16) kwenye lo. Kwa hivyo mvuto, bila shaka, huvuta kidogo sana kwako.
hypothesis: Mtu anaye uzito wa kilogramu 90 duniani angekuwa na uzito wa kilogramu 16 kwenye Io. Kwa hiyo, nguvu za uvutano zinakuvuta kwa urahisi.

source: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.
reference: Jua halina ganda gumu kama Dunia ambayo unaweza kusimama kwayo. Jua zima limetengenezwa kwa gesi, moto, na gesi ya utegili.
hypothesis: Jua haina utando kama dunia ambayo unaweza kusimama juu yake. Jua zima limeundwa na gesi, moto, na plasma.

source: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.
reference: Gesi huwa nyembamba kadiri unavyosonga mbali na Jua.
hypothesis: Gesi hiyo hupungua kadiri unavyokwenda mbali na katikati ya Jua.

source: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".
reference: Sehemu ya nje tunayoona tunapotazama jua inaitwa photosphere, kumaanisha “mpira wa mwanga”.
hypothesis: Sehemu ya nje tunayoona tunapotazama Jua huitwa photosphere, ikimaanisha "dhahabu ya nuru".

source: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.
reference: Takribani miaka elfu tatu baadaye, mnamo 1610, Mnajimu Muitaliano Galileo Galilei alitumia darubini kuangalia kwamba Zuhura ina awamu, kama vile mwezi.
hypothesis: Miaka elfu tatu hivi baadaye, katika 1610, mwastronomia Mwitaliano Galileo Galilei alitumia darubini kuona kwamba Sayari ya Duniani ina vipindi, kama vile mwezi unavyofanya.

source: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.
reference: Awamu hufanyika kwa sababu tu upande wa Zuhura (au wa Mwezi) unaoegemea upande wa Jua hupata mwanga. Awamu za Zuhura ziliunga mkono nadharia ya Kopernikasi kwamba sayari zinazunguka Jua.
hypothesis: Hatua hutokea kwa sababu tu upande wa Venus (au wa Mwezi) uso wa jua ni taa. Hatua ya Venus iliunga mkono nadharia ya Copernicus kwamba sayari kuzunguka jua.

source: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.
reference: Kisha, miaka michache baadaye mwaka wa 1639, mnajimu Mwingereza aliyeitwa Jeremiah Horrocks alitazama safari ya Venus.
hypothesis: Kisha, miaka michache baadaye katika 1639, mwastronomia Mwingereza aitwaye Jeremiah Horrocks aliona transit ya Venus.

source: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.
reference: Uingereza ilikuwa na uzoefu wa kipindi kirefu cha amani baada ya kushinda upya Danelaw.
hypothesis: Uingereza ilikuwa na kipindi kirefu cha amani baada ya kushinda tena Danelaw.

source: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.
reference: Walakini mnamo 991 Ethelred alikabiliwa na kundi la manowari la Viking kubwa kuliko lolote tangu la Guthrum karne moja mapema.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, katika 991 Ethelred alikabiliwa na meli kubwa ya Waviking kuliko meli nyingine yoyote tangu Guthrum karne moja mapema.

source: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.
reference: Manowari hizi ziliongozwa na Olaf Trygvasson, Mnorwei aliye na matarajio ya kurudisha nchi yake kutoka kwa utawala wa Kidenmaki.
hypothesis: Meli hiyo iliongozwa na Olaf Trygvasson, Mnorweji aliyekuwa na nia ya kuikomboa nchi yake kutoka kwa utawala wa Denmark.

source: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.
reference: Baada ya vipingamizi vya kwanza vya kijeshi, Ethelred aliweza kukubaliana kimasharti na Olaf, ambaye alirudi Norwe ili kujaribu kupata ufalme wake, kwa mafanikio mseto.
hypothesis: Baada ya kushindwa na jeshi mara ya kwanza, Ethelred aliweza kukubaliana na Olaf, ambaye alirudi Norway kujaribu kupata ufalme wake bila mafanikio.

source: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).
reference: Hangeul ndiyo alfabeti ya kipekee iliyovumbuliwa kimakusudi inayotumika kimaarufu kila siku. Alfabeti hiyo ilivumbuliwa mwaka wa 1444 wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Sejong (1418 – 1450).
hypothesis: Hangeul ni alfabeti pekee iliyobuniwa kwa makusudi katika matumizi ya kila siku ya watu. Alfabeti hiyo ilibuniwa mnamo 1444 wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Sejong (1418  1450).

source: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.
reference: Mfalme Sejong alikua ndiye mfalme wa nne kwenye Nasaba ya Joseon na ndiye aliyezingatiwa Zaidi.
hypothesis: Mfalme Sejong alikuwa mfalme wa nne wa nasaba ya Joseon na ni mmoja wa wafalme wenye kuheshimiwa sana.

source: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".
reference: Mwanzoni aliipatia alfabeti ya Hangeul jina la Hunmin Jeongeum, kumaanisha “sauti sahihi za maagizo kwa watu”.
hypothesis: Mwanzoni aliita alfabeti ya Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum, ikimaanisha "sauti sahihi kwa ajili ya kufundisha watu".

source: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.
reference: Kuna nadharia nyingi kuhusu vile Sanskrit ilikuja kuwepo. Mojawapo ni kuhusu uhamaji wa Aryan kutoka magharibi hadi India waliokuja na lugha yao.
hypothesis: Kuna nadharia nyingi kuhusu jinsi Sanskrit ilivyotokea. Moja ni kuhusu uhamiaji wa Aryan kutoka magharibi kwenda India ambao walileta lugha yao nao.

source: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.
reference: Sanskrit ni lugha ya kale na inaweza kulinganishwa na lugha ya Kilatini inayozungumzwa Uropa.
hypothesis: Lugha ya Kisanskri ni ya kale na inaweza kulinganishwa na lugha ya Kilatini inayozungumzwa Ulaya.

source: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.
reference: Kitabu cha mapema zaidi kijulikanacho duniani kiliandikwa kwa Sanskrit. Baada ya utungaji wa Upanishads, Sanskrit ilififia tu kwa sababu ya mfumo wa viwango.
hypothesis: Kitabu cha kwanza kinachojulikana duniani kilikuwa kimeandikwa kwa Kiswahili. Baada ya mkusanyiko wa Upanishads, Kiswahili tu faded kutokana na uongozi.

source: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.
reference: Sanskrit ni lugha tata na tajiri sana, ambayo imekuwa chanzo cha lugha nyingi za kisasa za Kihindi, kama vile Kilatini ilivyo chanzo cha lugha za Kizungu kama vile Kifaransa na Kispanya.
hypothesis: Sanskrit ni lugha ngumu sana na tajiri, ambayo imetumiwa kuwa chanzo cha lugha nyingi za kisasa za India, kama vile Kilatini ni chanzo cha lugha za Ulaya kama Kifaransa na Kihispania.

source: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.
reference: Vita kwa Ufaransa vikiwa vimekwisha, Ujerumani ilianza kujitayarisha kuvamia kisiwa cha Uingereza.
hypothesis: Vita vya Ufaransa vilipokwisha, Ujerumani ilianza kujitayarisha kuvamia kisiwa cha Uingereza.

source: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.
reference: Ujerumani ililipa shambulio jina lililosimbwa la "Operation Sealion". Silaha nyingi nzito na vifaa vya Jeshi la Uingereza vilikuwa vimepotea wakati wa kutoka Dunkirk, kwa hivyo jeshi lilikuwa dhaifu kiasi.
hypothesis: Ujerumani code-jina shambulio  Operesheni Sealion. Wengi wa silaha nzito ya Jeshi la Uingereza na vifaa walikuwa wamepotea wakati wa kuondoka kutoka Dunkirk, hivyo jeshi ilikuwa ni dhaifu.

source: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.
reference: Lakini Nevi ya Kifalme bado ilikuwa imara sana zaidi ya Nevi ya Ujerumani ("Kriegsmarine") na ingeweza kuangamiza kikosi chochote cha ushambuliaji kilichotumwa katika Mlango-bahari wa Uingereza.
hypothesis: Lakini Royal Navy bado ilikuwa na nguvu zaidi kuliko Jeshi la Wanamaji la Ujerumani (Kriegsmarine) na ingeweza kuharibu meli yoyote ya uvamizi iliyopelekwa kuvuka Channel ya Uingereza.

source: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.
reference: Kwa hali yoyote, ni meli chache sana za jeshi la kifalme zilizo karibu na njia za uvamizi kwa sababu wanahofia kusamishwa na mashambulizi ya hewa ya Kijerumani.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, meli chache sana za Royal Navy zilikuwa karibu na njia za uvamizi kwani majeshi ya meli ya Uingereza yaliogopa kwamba ingeweza kuzama kwa shambulio la anga la Ujerumani.

source: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.
reference: Hebu tuanze na maelezo kuhusu mipango ya Italia. Italia ilikuwa hasa “kaka mdogo” wa Ujerumani na Japani.
hypothesis: Hebu kuanza na ufafanuzi kuhusu mipango ya Italia. Italia ilikuwa hasa "ndugu mdogo" wa Ujerumani na Japan.

source: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.
reference: Ilikuwa na jeshi dhaifu na nevi dhaifu, ingawa walikuwa wamejenga tu meli nne mpya kabla ya kuanza kwa vita.
hypothesis: Ilikuwa na jeshi na jeshi la wanamaji dhaifu zaidi, ingawa walikuwa wamejenga meli nne mpya kabla tu ya kuanza kwa vita.

source: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.
reference: Malengo makuu ya Italiano yalikuwa nchi za Kiafrika. Ili kunasa nchi hizo, walihitaji kuwa na pedi ya kurushia vikosi, ili vikosi viweze kusafiri katika Bahari ya Mediteranea na kuishambulia Afrika.
hypothesis: Lengo kuu la Italia lilikuwa nchi za Afrika. Ili kukamata nchi hizo, wangehitaji kuwa na jukwaa la kutekeleza jeshi, ili jeshi liweze kusafiri kupitia Bahari ya Mediterania na kuvamia Afrika.

source: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.
reference: Kwa hayo, walihitaji kuondoa kambi na meli za Uingereza kutoka Misri. Zaidi ya hatua hizo, manowari za Italia hazikupaswa kufanya lingine lolote.
hypothesis: Kwa hiyo, walipaswa kuondoa misingi ya Uingereza na meli huko Misri. Mbali na vitendo hivyo, meli za vita za Italia hazikupaswa kufanya kitu kingine chochote.

source: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.
reference: Sasa kwa Japani. Japani ilikuwa nchi ya kisiwa, kama vile Uingereza.
hypothesis: Sasa kuhusu Japani. Japani ilikuwa kisiwa cha nchi, kama vile Uingereza.

source: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.
reference: Sabmarini ni meli zilizoundwa kusafiri chini ya maji, na kubaki hapo kwa muda mrefu.
hypothesis: Submarines ni meli iliyoundwa kusafiri chini ya maji, na kubaki huko kwa muda mrefu.

source: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.
reference: Nyambizi zilitumiwa katika vita vya pili vya dunia. Wakati huo zilisonga polepole sana na zilikuwa na masafa mafupi sana ya upigaji risasi.
hypothesis: Submarines zilitumiwa katika Vita Kuu ya Kwanza na Vita Kuu ya Pili. Nyuma wakati huo walikuwa polepole sana na alikuwa na umbali wa risasi mdogo sana.

source: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.
reference: Mwanzoni mwa vita zilisonga mara nyingi juu ya bahari, lakini kadiri rada ilivyoanza kukua na kupata usahihi zaidi nyambizi zililazimika kuzama chini ya maji ili kuepuka kuonekana.
hypothesis: Mwanzoni mwa vita wao hasa kusafiri juu ya bahari, lakini kama radar ilianza kuendeleza na kuwa sahihi zaidi submarines walikuwa kulazimishwa kwenda chini ya maji ili kuepuka kuonekana.

source: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.
reference: Manowari za Ujerumani ziliitwa nyambizi. Wajerumani walikuwa wazuri sana kwa kuabiri na kuendesha manowari zao.
hypothesis: Ujerumani ilikuwa nzuri sana katika navigating na kuendesha submarines yao.

source: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.
reference: Kwa sababu ya mafanikio yao na nyambizi, baada ya vita Wajerumani hawaaminiki kuwa na nyingi zazo.
hypothesis: Kwa sababu ya mafanikio yao na submarines, baada ya vita Wajerumani si kuaminiwa kuwa na wengi wao.

source: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.
reference: Ndiyo! Mfalme Tutankhamuni, ambaye wakati mwingine hutambuliwa kama “Mfalme Tuti” au “Mfalme Mvulana”, ni mmojawapo wa wafalme wa zamani wa Misri wanaojulikana sana katika nyakati za sasa.
hypothesis: Mfalme Tutankhamun, ambaye nyakati nyingine anaitwa "Mfalme Tut" au "Mfalme Mvulana", ni mmoja wa wafalme wa Misri ya kale wanaojulikana sana katika nyakati za kisasa.

source: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.
reference: Kwa kushangaza, hakuchukuliwa kuwa muhimu katika zamani za kale na hakurekodiwa kwenye nyingi za orodha za wafalme.
hypothesis: Kwa kupendeza, hakuonwa kuwa mtu wa maana sana katika nyakati za kale na hakuorodheshwa katika orodha nyingi za wafalme wa kale.

source: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.
reference: Hata hivyo, ugunduzi wa kaburi lake mnamo 1922 ulimfanya mtu mashuhuri. Huku makaburi mengi ya zamani yakiporwa, kaburi hili liliachwa karibu bila kusumbuliwa kamwe.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, alijulikana sana baada ya kugunduliwa kaburi lake mwaka wa 1922. Ingawa makaburi mengi ya zamani yalipigwa, kaburi hili halikuharibiwa.

source: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.
reference: Vitu vingi vilivyozikwa na Tutankhamun vimehifadhiwa vizuri, ikiwa ni pamoja na maelfu ya sanaa zilizoundwa kutoka kwa madini ya thamani na mawe adimu.
hypothesis: Vitu vingi vilivyopatikana pamoja na Tutankhamun vimehifadhiwa vizuri, kutia ndani maelfu ya vitu vilivyotengenezwa kwa metali zenye thamani na mawe yasiyo ya kawaida.

source: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.
reference: Uvumbuzi wa magurudumu ya spoki ulifanya magari ya Ashuru yawe mepesi, haraka, na yaliyo tayari zaidi kushinda askari na magari mengine.
hypothesis: Uvumbuzi wa magurudumu yenye kuelea ulifanya magari ya vita ya Waashuru yawe mepesi, ya haraka, na yawe tayari zaidi kukimbia kuliko askari-jeshi na magari mengine.

source: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.
reference: Mishale kutoka kwenye nyuta zao hatari ingeweza kupenya ngao za askari wapinzani. Takribani 1000 BC, Waashuru walianzisha farasi wa kwanza wa vita.
hypothesis: Mapigo kutoka kwa mapanga yao yenye kuua yangeweza kupenya ndani ya silaha za askari wapinzani. Karibu 1000 K.W.K., Waashuru walianzisha jeshi la kwanza la wapanda farasi.

source: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.
reference: Askari farasi ni jeshi linalopigana juu ya farasi. Matandiko yalikuwa bado hayajavumbuliwa, kwa hivyo askari farasi wa Ashuru walipigana kwenye migongo tupu ya farasi wao.
hypothesis: Jeshi la wapanda farasi ni jeshi linalopigana kwa farasi. Kwa kuwa nyumbu halikuwa limevumbuliwa, askari wa askari wapanda farasi wa Ashuru walipigana kwa miguu yao.

source: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.
reference: Tunawajua wengi wa wanasiasa, wanasayansi na wasanii wa Ugiriki. Yamkini mtu anayejulikana sana katika utamaduni huu ni Homer, malenga wa mashairi aliyekuwa kipofu, aliyebuni tungo mbili bora sana za fasihi ya Kigiriki: mashairi Iliad na Odyssey.
hypothesis: Huenda mtu anayejulikana zaidi wa utamaduni huo ni Homer, mshairi kipofu wa kihistoria, aliyeandika mashairi mawili ya kustaajabisha ya Kigiriki: Iliad na Odyssey.

source: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.
reference: Sophocles na Aristophanes bado ni waandishi maarufu wa michezo ya kuigiza na michezo yao huzingatiwa kuwa miongoni mwa kazi kubwa za fasihi ya ulimwengu.
hypothesis: Sophocles na Aristophanes bado ni waandishi maarufu wa michezo ya kuigiza na michezo yao ya kuigiza inachukuliwa kuwa miongoni mwa kazi kubwa zaidi za fasihi ya ulimwengu.

source: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.
reference: Mgiriki mwingine maarufu ni Pythagoras, anayejulikana sana kwa nadharia zake maarufu za hisabati kuhusu uhusiano wa pande za pembe tatu zenye pembemraba.
hypothesis: Mgiriki mwingine mashuhuri ni mwanahisabati Pythagoras, anayejulikana hasa kwa theorem yake maarufu kuhusu uhusiano wa pande za pembetatu.

source: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.
reference: Kuna makadirio yanayotofautiana kuhusu idadi ya watu wanaozungumza Kihindi. Inakadiriwa kuwa kati ya lugha nambari mbili na nne inayozungumzwa zaidi duniani.
hypothesis: Kuna makadirio tofauti ya watu wangapi wanaozungumza Kihindi. Inakadiriwa kuwa kati ya lugha ya pili na ya nne inayozungumzwa zaidi ulimwenguni.

source: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.
reference: Idadi ya wazungumzaji wenyeji hutofautiana kulingana na kama lahaja zinazohusiana kwa karibu sana zinahesabiwa au la.
hypothesis: Idadi ya wasemaji wa asili hutofautiana ikitegemea kama lahaja zinazohusiana sana zinahesabiwa au la.

source: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.
reference: Makadirio yanafikia wasemaji milioni 340 hadi milioni 500, na watu wengi kama milioni 800 wanaweza kuielewa lugha hiyo.
hypothesis: Inakadiriwa kwamba kuna watu milioni 340 hadi milioni 500 wanaozungumza lugha hiyo, na watu milioni 800 wanaweza kuielewa.

source: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.
reference: Kihindi na Kiurdu zinafanana kwa msamiati lakini tofauti katika hati; katika mazungumzo ya kila siku, wazungumzaji wa lugha zote mbili wanaweza kuelewana.
hypothesis: Kihindi na Kiurdu ni sawa katika msamiati lakini tofauti katika maandishi; katika mazungumzo ya kila siku, wasemaji wa lugha zote mbili kwa kawaida wanaweza kuelewana.

source: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.
reference: Karibu karne ya 15, Estonia kaskazini ilikuwa chini ya ushawishi mkubwa wa kiutamaduni wa Ujerumani.
hypothesis: Karibu na karne ya 15, kaskazini mwa Estonia lilipata ushawishi mkubwa wa kitamaduni kutoka Ujerumani.

source: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.
reference: Watawa wengine wa Kijerumani walitaka kumleta Mungu karibu na watu asili, kwa hivyo wakabuni lugha halisi ya Kiestonia
hypothesis: Watawa fulani Wajerumani walitaka kumkaribia Mungu zaidi watu wa asili, kwa hiyo wakabuni lugha ya Kiestonia.

source: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.
reference: Ilihusishwa na alfabeti ya kijerumani na alfabeti moja "Õ/õ" ikaongezwa.
hypothesis: Ilitokana na alfabeti ya Kijerumani na herufi moja "Õ/õ" iliongezwa.

source: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.
reference: Kadiri muda ulivyopita, maneno mengi yaliyoombwa kutoka Ujerumani yalichanganyika. Huu ulikuwa mwanzo wa uelewa.
hypothesis: Kadiri wakati ulivyopita, maneno mengi yaliyopokewa kutoka Kijerumani yaliunganishwa.

source: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.
reference: Kitamaduni, mrithi wa kiti cha enzi angeenda moja kwa moja kwa uanajeshi baada ya kuhitimu shuleni.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida, mrithi wa kiti cha ufalme angeenda moja kwa moja jeshini baada ya kumaliza shule.

source: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).
reference: Walakini, Charles alienda katika Trinity College, Cambridge mahali alisomea Anthropolojia na Akiolojia, na baadaye Historia, akapokea 2:2 (shahada ya pili kutoka chini).
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, Charles alienda chuo kikuu katika Chuo cha Trinity, Cambridge ambapo alisoma Anthropology na Archaeology, na baadaye Historia, akipata 2:2 (darasa la chini la darasa la pili).

source: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.
reference: Charles alikuwa memba wa kwanza wa Familia ya Kifalme ya Kiingereza kuzawadiwa shahada ya digrii.
hypothesis: Charles alikuwa mshiriki wa kwanza wa familia ya kifalme ya Uingereza kupewa shahada ya uongozi.

source: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.
reference: Uturuki ya Ulaya (Thrace mashariki au Rumelia katika rasi ya Balka) inajumuisha asilimia 3 ya nchi.
hypothesis: Uturuki ya Ulaya (Thrasia ya mashariki au Rumelia katika peninsula ya Balkan) inajumuisha 3% ya nchi.

source: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.
reference: Wilaya ya Uturuki ni zaidi ya kilomita 1,600 (maili 1,000) urefu na kilomita 800 (maili 500) upana, na takriban umbo la mstatili.
hypothesis: Eneo la Uturuki lina urefu wa zaidi ya kilomita 1,600 na upana wa kilomita 800, na lina umbo la mstatili.

source: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.
reference: Sehemu ya Uturuki, pamoja na maziwa, imekalia kilomita mraba 783, 562 (maili mraba 300, 948), ambazo kilomita mraba 755,688 (maili mraba 291,773) kati yake ziko kusini magharibi mwa Asia na kilomita mraba 23,764 (maili mraba 9,174) ziko barani Ulaya.
hypothesis: Eneo la Uturuki, ikiwa ni pamoja na maziwa, lina kilomita za mraba 783,562 (300,948 sq mi), ambayo kilomita za mraba 755,688 (291,773 sq mi) ziko kusini magharibi mwa Asia na kilomita za mraba 23,764 (9,174 sq mi) huko Ulaya.

source: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.
reference: Eneo la Uturuki huifanya kuwa nchi ya 37 kwa ukubwa duniani, na ina takriban saizi za Ufaransa ya Uropa na Uingereza kwa pamoja.
hypothesis: Eneo la Uturuki hufanya nchi hiyo kuwa nchi ya 37 kwa ukubwa ulimwenguni, na ni karibu ukubwa wa Ufaransa ya Metropolitan na Uingereza pamoja.

source: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.
reference: Uturuki imezungukwa na maziwa katika pande tatu: Bahari ya Aegea upande wa magharibi, Bahari Nyeusi upande wa kaskazini na Bahari ya Mediterania upande wa kusini.
hypothesis: Uturuki imezungukwa na bahari tatu: Bahari ya Aegean upande wa magharibi, Bahari Nyeusi upande wa kaskazini na Bahari ya Mediterania upande wa kusini.

source: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.
reference: Luxembourg ina historia ndefu lakini uhuru wake ni wa kutoka mwaka wa 1839.
hypothesis: Luxemburg ina historia ndefu lakini uhuru wake ulianza mwaka wa 1839.

source: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.
reference: Baadhi ya sehemu za sasa za Ubelgiji zilikuwa sehemu ya Lusembagi zamani lakini zikawa za Kibelgiji baada ya Mapinduzi ya Kibelgiji ya 1830.
hypothesis: Sehemu za leo za Ubelgiji zilikuwa sehemu ya Luxemburg zamani lakini zikawa Ubelgiji baada ya Mapinduzi ya Ubelgiji ya 1830.

source: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.
reference: Lusembagi daima imejaribu kuwa nchi isiyoegemea upande wowote lakini ilichukuliwa na Ujerumani katika Vita vya kwanza na vya pili vya Dunia.
hypothesis: Luxemburg daima imejaribu kubaki nchi isiyo na upande wowote lakini ilikuwa imechukuliwa na Ujerumani katika Vita vya Kwanza vya Ulimwengu na Vita vya Pili vya Ulimwengu.

source: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.
reference: Mnamo 1957 Luxembourg ikawa memba mwanzilishi wa shirika ambalo leo linajulikana kama Umoja wa Ulaya.
hypothesis: Katika 1957 Luxemburg ikawa mwanachama mwanzilishi wa shirika ambalo leo linajulikana kama Umoja wa Ulaya.

source: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).
reference: Drukgyal Dzong ni ngome iliyoharibika na monasteri ya Kibudhi katika sehemu ya juu ya Wilaya ya Paro (katika Kijiji cha Phondrey).
hypothesis: Drukgyal Dzong ni ngome na makao ya watawa wa Buddha katika sehemu ya juu ya Wilaya ya Paro (katika Kijiji cha Phondey).

source: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.
reference: Inasemekana kwamba mnamo 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel aliunda ngome hiyo kama ukumbusho wa ushindi wake dhidi ya vikosi vya Tibeti na Mongoli.
hypothesis: Inasemekana kwamba katika mwaka wa 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel alijenga ngome hiyo ili kukumbuka ushindi wake dhidi ya majeshi ya Wamongolia wa Tibet.

source: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
reference: Mnamo 1951, moto ulifanya baadhi tu ya masalio ya Drukgyal Dzong kubakia, kama vile picha ya Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
hypothesis: Katika mwaka wa 1951, moto ulifanya baadhi tu ya vitu vya kale vya Drukgyal Dzong vibaki, kama vile sanamu ya Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

source: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.
reference: Baada ya moto, ngome ilihifadhiwa na kulindwa, na kubaki kuwa mojawapo ya vivutio vya kusisimua zaidi vya Bhutan.
hypothesis: Baada ya moto, ngome hiyo ilihifadhiwa na kulindwa, na kubaki kuwa mojawapo ya vitu vya kuvutia zaidi vya Bhutan.

source: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.
reference: Wakati wa karne ya 18 Kambodia ilijipata imebanwa katikati mwa majirani wawili wenye nguvu, Thailandi na Vietnam.
hypothesis: Katika karne ya 18, Kambodia ilijikuta ikiwa imechunwa-chunwa kati ya majirani wawili wenye nguvu, Thailand na Vietnam.

source: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.
reference: Wathai walivamia Kambodia mara kadhaa katika karne ya 18 na mnamo 1772 wakaangamiza Phnom Phen.
hypothesis: Wathai walivamia Kambodia mara kadhaa katika karne ya 18 na mwaka wa 1772 waliharibu Phnom Phen.

source: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.
reference: Katika miaka ya mwisho ya karne ya 18 Wavietinamu pia waliivamia Kambodia.
hypothesis: Katika miaka ya mwisho ya karne ya 18 Wavietnam pia walivamia Kambodia.

source: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.
reference: Asilimia kumi na nane ya Wavenezuela hawana ajira, na wengi wa wale walioajiriwa hufanya kazi katika sekta isiyo rasmi.
hypothesis: Asilimia 18 ya Wavenezuela hawana kazi, na wengi wa wale walioajiriwa hufanya kazi katika uchumi usio rasmi.

source: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.
reference: Thuluthi mbili ya Wavenezuela ambao hufanya kazi hufanya hivyo katika sekta ya huduma, karibu robo yao hufanya kazi katika viwanda na humusi hufanya kazi katika kilimo.
hypothesis: Theluthi mbili ya Wavenezuela wanaofanya kazi hufanya hivyo katika sekta ya huduma, karibu robo hufanya kazi katika viwanda na robo hufanya kazi katika kilimo.

source: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.
reference: Sekta muhimu kwa Wavenezuela ni mafuta, ambapo nchi hiyo ni wauzaji nje, ingawa ni asilimia moja tu wanaofanya kazi katika sekta ya mafuta.
hypothesis: Viwanda muhimu kwa Wavenezuela ni mafuta, ambako nchi hiyo ni muuzaji nje wa mafuta, ingawa ni asilimia moja tu ya watu wanaofanya kazi katika viwanda vya mafuta.

source: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.
reference: Mapema katika uhuru wa nchi, utaalamu wa Singapori katika Bustani za Mimea uliisaidia katika kukigeuza kisiwa hicho kuwa Mji wa Bustani wa kitropiki.
hypothesis: Mapema katika uhuru wa taifa hilo, ustadi wa Bustani za Mimea ya Singapore ulisaidia kugeuza kisiwa hicho kuwa Jiji la Bustani la kitropiki.

source: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.
reference: Mnamo 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, okidi mseto, lilichaguliwa kama ua la kitaifa la nchi hiyo.
hypothesis: Mwaka wa 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, aina ya okidi iliyochanganywa, ilichaguliwa kuwa ua la kitaifa la taifa hilo.

source: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.
reference: Kila mwaka karibu Oktoba wala-mimea milioni 1.5 husafiri kuelekea nyanda za kusini, na kuvuka Mto Mara, kutoka vilima vya kaskazini kwa ajili ya mvua.
hypothesis: Kila mwaka karibu Oktoba karibu wanyama-watiwa-majani milioni 1.5 husafiri kuelekea nyanda za kusini, wakivuka Mto Mara, kutoka vilima vya kaskazini ili kupata mvua.

source: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.
reference: Kisha tena kurudi kaskazini kupitia magharibi, na kuvuka mto Mara mara nyingine tena, baada ya mvua karibu Aprili.
hypothesis: Kisha kurudi kaskazini kupitia magharibi, tena kuvuka mto Mara, baada ya mvua mnamo Aprili.

source: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.
reference: Eneo la Serengeti lina Mbuga la Kitaifa la Serengeti, Eneo la Uhifadhi la Ngorongoro na Hifadhi ya Wanyamapori ya Maswa katika Tanzania na Hifadhi ya Kitaifa ya Maasai Mara katika Kenya.
hypothesis: Eneo la Serengeti lina Hifadhi ya Kitaifa ya Serengeti, Eneo la Hifadhi ya Ngorongoro na Hifadhi ya Wanyama ya Maswa nchini Tanzania na Hifadhi ya Kitaifa ya Maasai Mara nchini Kenya.

source: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)
reference: Kujifunza kuunda vyombo vya habari vyenye mwingiliano kunahitaji ujuzi wa kawaida na wa jadi, na vile vile vifaa vilivyotengenezwa katika darasa la mwingiliano (hadithi za vibao, uhariri wa sauti na video, hadithi za hadithi, nk.)
hypothesis: Kujifunza kujenga vyombo vya habari interactive inahitaji ujuzi wa kawaida na jadi, pamoja na zana mastered katika madarasa interactive (storyboarding, sauti na video uhariri, hadithi akizungumza, nk)

source: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.
reference: Ubunifu wenye maingiliano huhitaji kwamba ukague tena dhana zako kuhusu uzalishaji wa midia na ujifunze kufikiria kwa njia zisizo nyoofu.
hypothesis: Interactive kubuni inahitaji kwamba wewe upya tathmini yako dhana kuhusu uzalishaji wa vyombo vya habari na kujifunza kufikiri katika njia zisizo linear.

source: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.
reference: Ubunifu wa maingiliano unahitaji kuwa sehemu za mradi ziunganike, lakini pia ziwe na mantiki kama sehemu tofauti.
hypothesis: Interactive kubuni inahitaji kwamba vipengele vya mradi kuunganisha na kila mmoja, lakini pia kufanya maana kama chombo tofauti.

source: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.
reference: Ubaya wa lenzi za kupanua au kupunguza mwonekano ni kwamba utata wa kiangalifu na idadi ya elementi za lenzi zinazohitajika kufikia urefu wa kiangalifu ni kubwa zaidi kuliko za lenzi kuu.
hypothesis: Hasara ya lenzi za zoom ni kwamba utata wa kioo na idadi ya vipengele vya lenzi zinazohitajika kufikia urefu wa kioo ni kubwa zaidi kuliko kwa lenzi za msingi.

source: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.
reference: Hili linaendelea kuwa suala lisilo la muhimu jinsi watengenezaji wa lenzi wanavyofikia viwango vya juu katika uzalizaji wa lenzi.
hypothesis: Hilo linazidi kuwa tatizo kidogo, kwa kuwa wazalishaji wa lenzi wanafikia viwango vya juu zaidi vya kutengeneza lenzi.

source: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.
reference: Hii imewezesha lenzi za kukuza kutoa picha zenye ubora unaoweza kulinganishwa na ule unaofikiwa na lenzi zenye urefu msingi usiobadilika.
hypothesis: Hilo limefanya lensi za zoom ziweze kutoa picha zenye ubora unaolingana na ule unaopatikana kwa lensi zenye urefu wa kutazama.

source: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.
reference: Ubaya mwingine wa lenzi za ukuzaji ni kuwa kilango kipana zaidi (kasi) cha lenzi kwa kawaida huwa cha chini.
hypothesis: Hasara nyingine ya lenzi za zoom ni kwamba kipenyo cha juu cha lenzi (kasi) kwa kawaida ni cha chini.

source: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.
reference: Hii hufanya lenzi za kukuza za bei ya chini vigumu kutumia katika hali ya mwangaza duni bila mwako.
hypothesis: Hilo hufanya iwe vigumu kutumia lenzi za bei nafuu za kupanua kwenye hali zenye mwangaza mdogo bila flash.

source: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.
reference: Shida moja ya kawaida wakati wa kujaribu kubadilisha sinema kwenda kwa muundo wa DVD ni kuskani zaidi.
hypothesis: Moja ya matatizo ya kawaida wakati kujaribu kubadilisha filamu kwa umbizo DVD ni overscan.

source: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.
reference: Vipindi vingi vya televisheni nyingi hutengenezwa kwa njia ya kufurahisha umma.
hypothesis: Televisheni nyingi hutengenezwa kwa njia ya kuwapendeza watu wa kawaida.

source: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.
reference: Kwa sababu hiyo, kila kitu mnachokiona kwenye runinga kilikatwa mipaka, juu, chini na pande.
hypothesis: Kwa sababu hiyo, kila kitu unachokiona kwenye televisheni kilikuwa na mipaka iliyokatwa, juu, chini na pande.

source: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.
reference: Hii hufanywa ili kuhakikisha picha inafunika skrini yote. Hiyo inaitwa kuskani kulikokithiri.
hypothesis: Hii ni kufanyika ili kuhakikisha kwamba picha kufunika screen nzima. Hiyo inaitwa overscan.

source: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.
reference: Kwa bahati mbaya, unapotengeneza DVD, kuna uwezekano kingo zake zitakatwa pia, na kama video ilikuwa na maandishi ya tafsiri yaliyokuwa karibu sana na chini, pia hayataonyeshwa.
hypothesis: Kwa bahati mbaya, wakati wewe kufanya DVD, ni mipaka pengine itakuwa kukatwa pia, na kama video alikuwa na vichwa vya habari karibu sana na chini, wao si kuonyesha kikamilifu.

source: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.
reference: Kasri la kiasili la zama za kati lilichochea dhana, na kuleta picha za mashindano ya kivita, karamu na uungwana wa Kiartha.
hypothesis: Jumba la kifalme la kale la kale limekuwa likichochea mawazo kwa muda mrefu, likichochea picha za mashindano ya vita, karamu, na ushujaa wa Arthur.

source: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.
reference: Hata kwa kusimama katikati mwa magofu ya miaka elfu ni rahisi kuwa na taswira ya sauti na harufu ya vita vilivyopita kitambo, na karibu kusikia mlio wa kwato kwenye barabara za mawe na kunusa uoga kutoka kwenye jela za chini kwa chini.
hypothesis: Hata ukisimama katikati ya magofu ya miaka elfu moja ni rahisi kukumbuka sauti na harufu za vita vilivyopita zamani, kusikia karibu mlio wa magamba kwenye mawe ya mawe na kunusa hofu ikiinuka kutoka kwenye mashimo ya gereza.

source: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?
reference: Lakini fikira zetu zina misingi ya ukweli? Mbona ngome zilijengwa pale mwanzoni? Zilibuniwa na kujengwa vipi?
hypothesis: Lakini je, mawazo yetu yanategemea mambo halisi? Kwa nini majumba yalijengwa? Yalibuniwa na kujengwaje?

source: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.
reference: Kwa kawaida ya kipindi hicho, Ngome ya Kirby Muxloe ni zaidi ya nyumba ambayo imeimarishwa kuliko ngome ya kweli.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida kwa kipindi hicho, Kirby Muxloe Castle ni zaidi ya nyumba imara kuliko ngome halisi.

source: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.
reference: Madirisha yenye glasi kubwa na kuta nyembamba hazingeweza kupinga shambulio kwa muda mrefu.
hypothesis: Madirisha yake makubwa yenye kioo na kuta zake nyembamba hazingeweza kupinga shambulio la kimakusudi kwa muda mrefu.

source: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.
reference: Katika miaka ya 1480, wakati ujenzi wake ulipoanzishwa na Bwana Hastings, nchi ilikuwa yenye amani kiasi na ulinzi ulihitajika tu dhidi ya vikundi vidogo vya wanyang’anyi.
hypothesis: Katika miaka ya 1480, wakati ujenzi wake ulipoanza na Bwana Hastings, nchi ilikuwa na amani na ulinzi ulihitajika tu dhidi ya vikundi vidogo vya waporaji wanaotembea.

source: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.
reference: Usawasishaji wa mamlaka ulikuwa mfumo ambamo mataifa ya Ulaya yalitafuta kudumisha uhuru wa majimbo yote ya Ulaya.
hypothesis: Usawa wa nguvu ulikuwa mfumo ambao mataifa ya Ulaya yalijitahidi kudumisha uhuru wa kitaifa wa mataifa yote ya Ulaya.

source: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.
reference: Dhana ilikuwa kwamba mataifa yote ya Ulaya lazima yangejaribu kuzuia taifa moja lisiwe lenye nguvu, na basi serikali za kitaifa mara nyingi zilibadili muungano wao ili kudumisha usawa.
hypothesis: Wazo lilikuwa kwamba mataifa yote ya Ulaya yalipaswa kujaribu kuzuia taifa moja lisiwe na nguvu, na hivyo mara nyingi serikali za kitaifa zilibadili muungano wao ili kudumisha usawaziko.

source: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.
reference: Vita vya Urithi wa Uhispania viliashiria vita vya kwanza ambavyo shida yake kuu ilikuwa usawa wa madaraka.
hypothesis: Vita vya Kurithi vya Hispania vilikuwa vita vya kwanza ambavyo suala kuu lilikuwa usawa wa nguvu.

source: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.
reference: Hii iliashiria mabadiliko muhimu, kwani mamlaka ya Uingereza hawangeweza tena kujifanya kuwa vita vya kidini. Hivyo, Vita hivyo vya Miaka Thelathini vingekuwa vita vya mwisho kuitwa vita vya kidini.
hypothesis: Hilo lilikuwa badiliko muhimu, kwa kuwa mataifa yenye nguvu ya Ulaya hayangeweza tena kutumia kisingizio cha kuwa vita vya kidini. Hivyo, Vita vya Miaka Thelathini vingekuwa vita vya mwisho kutajwa kuwa vita vya kidini.

source: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.
reference: Hekalu ya Artemis kule Ephesus iliharibiwa julai 21, 356 BCE kwa kisa cha moto kilichotekelezwa na Herostratus.
hypothesis: Hekalu la Artemi huko Efeso liliharibiwa Julai 21, 356 K.W.K. katika tendo la kuchoma moto lililofanywa na Herostratus.

source: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.
reference: Kulingana na hadithi, motisha wake ulikuwa umaarufu kwa gharama yoyote. Waefeso, kwa kukasirika, walitangaza kuwa jina la Herostratus lisirekodiwe daima.
hypothesis: Kulingana na hadithi, nia yake ilikuwa umaarufu kwa gharama yoyote. Waefeso, waliokasirika, walitangaza kwamba jina la Herostratus halikuandikwa kamwe.

source: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.
reference: Mwanahistoria wa Kigiriki Strabo alibaini hilo jina, ambalo ndilo tunavyolijua leo. Hekalu liliharibiwa usiku ule ule Alexander Mkuu alizaliwa.
hypothesis: Baadaye, mwanahistoria Mgiriki Strabo aliandika kuhusu jina hilo, ambalo ni jina tunalolijua leo.

source: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.
reference: Alexander, kama mfalme, alijitolea kugharimia ujenzi upya wa hekalu, lakini toleo lake lilikataliwa. Baadaye, baada ya Alexander kufa, hekalu lilijengwa upya mnamo 323 BCE.
hypothesis: Alexander, kama mfalme, alitoa kulipa kwa ajili ya kujenga upya hekalu, lakini toleo lake lilikataliwa. Baadaye, baada ya kifo cha Alexander, hekalu lilijengwa upya katika 323 BCE.

source: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.
reference: Hakikisha mkono wako umetulia iwezekanavyo huku ukicheza sauti zote kwa usahihi - pia jaribu usifanye misogeo yoyote isiyo muhimu kwa vidole vyako.
hypothesis: Hakikisha mkono wako umepumzika kadiri iwezekanavyo huku ukipiga noti zote kwa usahihi - pia jaribu kutofanya harakati nyingi za kigeni na vidole vyako.

source: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.
reference: Hivi, utajisumbua kidogo iwezekanavyo. Kumbuka hakuna haja ya kugonga vibonye kwa nguvu nyingi ili kutoa sauti kubwakama kwenye piano.
hypothesis: Kwa njia hii, utachoka kidogo iwezekanavyo. Kumbuka kwamba si lazima uone vifungo kwa nguvu nyingi ili kupata sauti ya ziada kama vile kwenye piano.

source: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.
reference: Kwenye kodiani, kupata sauti ya ziada, unatumia viriba na shinikizo au kasi zaidi.
hypothesis: Kwenye akordioni, ili kupata sauti ya ziada, unatumia mipira kwa msukumo au kasi zaidi.

source: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.
reference: Utatanishi ni kuau tekeleza ushirika na, utambulisho na, ufahamu wa ukweli wa mwisho, uungu, ukweli au Mungu.
hypothesis: Ufumbo ni jitihada ya kushirikiana, kutambulishwa, au kuwa na ufahamu wa hali halisi ya mwisho, uungu, kweli ya kiroho, au Mungu.

source: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.
reference: Mwamini hutafuta uzoefu wa moja kwa moja, uelewa au maarifa ya ukweli/mungu au miungu
hypothesis: Muumini hutafuta uzoefu wa moja kwa moja, ufahamu, au ufahamu katika hali halisi ya kimungu / miungu au miungu.

source: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.
reference: Wafuasi hutafuta njia fulani za kuishi, au mazoea ambayo yanakusudiwa kulea uzoefu huo.
hypothesis: Wafuasi hufuata njia fulani za maisha, au mazoea ambayo yanakusudiwa kulea uzoefu huo.

source: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.
reference: Imani ya mafumbo inaweza kutofautishwa na aina nyingine za imani na ibada ya kidini kwa msisitizo wake wa uzoefu wa kibinafsi wa moja kwa moja wa hali ya kipekee ya ufahamu, hasa zile za sifa za amani, maarifa, raha au hata msisimko.
hypothesis: Ufumbo waweza kutofautishwa na aina nyinginezo za itikadi na ibada ya kidini kwa kukazia kwake uzoefu wa moja kwa moja wa kibinafsi wa hali ya kipekee ya fahamu, hasa zile za tabia ya amani, yenye ufahamu, yenye furaha, au hata yenye shangwe.

source: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.
reference: Kalasinga ni dini kutoka bara ndogo la India. Ilianzia eneo la Punjab katika karne ya 15 kutokana na mgawanyiko wa kimadhehebu katika tamaduni za Kihindu.
hypothesis: Sikhism ni dini kutoka India. Ilianzishwa katika mkoa wa Punjab wakati wa karne ya 15 kutoka mgawanyiko wa kidini ndani ya mila ya Kihindu.

source: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.
reference: Makalasinga huchukulia imani yao kuwa kando na Uhindu ingawa wanatambua mizizi na tamaduni zake katika Ubaniani.
hypothesis: Sikhs wanaona imani yao kuwa dini tofauti na Uhindu ingawa wanatambua mizizi na mila yake ya Kihindu.

source: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.
reference: Sikhs huiita dini yao Gurmat, ambayo ni Kipunjabi kwa "njia ya guru". Guru ni kipengele msingi cha dini zote za India lakini Ukalasinga umechukua umuhimu ambao hubuni msingi wa imani za Kalasinga.
hypothesis: Sikhs wito dini yao Gurmat, ambayo ni Punjabi kwa "njia ya guru". Guru ni kipengele cha msingi ya dini zote za India lakini katika Sikhism imechukua umuhimu kwamba inaunda msingi wa imani Sikh.

source: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.
reference: Dini ilianzishwa karne ya 15 na Guru Nanak 1469-1539). Palifuatilia urithi wa walimu tisa.
hypothesis: Dini hiyo ilianzishwa katika karne ya 15 na Guru Nanak (1469-1539).

source: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.
reference: Hata hivyo, mnamo Juni 1956, ahadi za Kruschev ziliwekwa katika jaribio wakati maandamano katika Polandi, ambapo wafanyakazi walikuwa wakipinga upungufu wa chakula na kukatwa kwa mishahara, yaligeuka kuwa maandamano ya jumla dhidi ya Ukomunisti.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, mnamo Juni 1956, ahadi za Khrushchev zilijaribiwa wakati ghasia huko Poland, ambako wafanyakazi walikuwa wakipiga kelele dhidi ya upungufu wa chakula na kupunguzwa kwa mshahara, zilipogeuka kuwa maandamano ya ujumla dhidi ya Ukomunisti.

source: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.
reference: Ingawa hatimaye, Kruschev alituma vifaru kurejesha utulivu, aliridhia baadhi ya mahitaji ya kiuchumi na akakubali kumteua mtu maarufu Wladyslaw Gomulka kama waziri mkuu mpya.
hypothesis: Ingawa hatimaye, Khrushchev alituma mizinga ili kurudisha utaratibu, aliruhusu matakwa fulani ya kiuchumi na kukubali kumteua Wladyslaw Gomulka aliyekuwa maarufu kuwa waziri mkuu mpya.

source: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.
reference: Ustaarabu wa Indus Valley ulikuwa wa Enzi za Shaba kaskazini magharibi mwa bara ndogo la Hindi, ukijumuisha kwa wingi Pakistani ya sasa na sehemu za kaskazini magharibi mwa Hindu na kaskazini magharibi mwa Afganistani.
hypothesis: Utamaduni wa Bonde la Indus ulikuwa ni ustaarabu wa Enzi ya Shaba katika kaskazini magharibi mwa bara la India, unaozunguka sehemu kubwa ya Pakistan ya kisasa na baadhi ya mikoa kaskazini magharibi mwa India na kaskazini mashariki mwa Afghanistan.

source: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.
reference: Ustaarabu ulinawiri katika bonde la Mto Indus ambapo ulitoa jina lake.
hypothesis: Utamaduni huo uliongezeka katika bonde la Mto Indus, na hivyo unapata jina lake.

source: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.
reference: Ingawa baadhi ya wasomi hukisia kwamba kwa sababu ustaarabu pia ulikuwapo katika mabonde ya Mto Sarasvati uliokauka sasa, unafaa kuitwa Ustaarabu wa Indus-Sarasvati, huku wengine wakiuita Ustaarabu wa Harappa, kutokana na Harappa, eneo lake la kwanza kuchimbwa katika miaka ya 1920.
hypothesis: Ingawa wasomi fulani wanakadiria kwamba kwa kuwa ustaarabu huo ulikuwepo pia katika mabwawa ya Mto Sarasvati ambao sasa umekauka, unapaswa kuitwa kwa kufaa Ustaarabu wa Indus-Sarasvati, wakati wengine wanauita Ustaarabu wa Harappan baada ya Harappa, wa kwanza wa maeneo yake kuchimbwa katika miaka ya 1920.

source: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.
reference: Tabia za kijeshi za Milki ya Kirumi zilisaidia sana kwa maendeleo ya matibabu.
hypothesis: Hali ya kijeshi ya milki ya Roma ilisaidia maendeleo ya kitiba.

source: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.
reference: Madaktari walianza kuajiriwa na Mtawala Augustus na hata kuunda kitengo kikubwa cha kwanza cha Matibabu cha Kirumi kwa ajili ya kutumika baada ya vita.
hypothesis: Madaktari walianza kuajiriwa na Maliki Augusto na hata wakaanzisha Kikosi cha kwanza cha Kiroma cha Matibabu kwa ajili ya matumizi baada ya vita.

source: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.
reference: Madaktari wa upasuaji walikuwa na uelewa wa vitulizo kadhaa zikiwamo mofini kutoka kwa mbegu za mpopi na scopolamina kutoka kwa mbegu za henbeni.
hypothesis: Madaktari wa upasuaji walijua dawa mbalimbali za kutuliza kutia ndani morphine kutoka kwa mbegu za mto na scopolamine kutoka kwa mbegu za mto.

source: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.
reference: Walipata kuwa na ustadi wa kukata viungo vya mwili ili kuokoa wagonjwa kutokana na gangrini na vile vile mafundo na vibanio vya mishipa ili kutuliza mtiririko wa damu.
hypothesis: Walikuwa stadi katika kukata viungo ili kuokoa wagonjwa kutokana na ugonjwa wa kupooza damu na pia kutumia visehemu vya kuunganisha mishipa ya damu ili kuzuia mtiririko wa damu.

source: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.
reference: Katika karne nyingi, milki ya Kirumi ilipelekea faida kubwa katika uga wa tiba na ikaunda mengi ya maarifa tunayoyajua leo.
hypothesis: Kwa karne nyingi, Milki ya Roma ilifanya maendeleo makubwa katika nyanja ya tiba na kuunda mengi ya ujuzi tunaoujua leo.

source: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.
reference: Pureland origami ni origami yenye kizuizi kwamba ni kunjo moja tu linaweza fanywa kwa wakati Fulani, kunjo ngumu zaidi kama kunjo za nyuma haziruhusiwi, na kunjo zote zina maeneo moja kwa moja.
hypothesis: Origami ya nchi safi ni origami na kizuizi kwamba fold moja tu inaweza kufanywa kwa wakati mmoja, folds ngumu zaidi kama folds za nyuma haziruhusiwi, na folds zote zina maeneo ya moja kwa moja.

source: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.
reference: Iliundwa na John Smith miaka ya 1970 kusaidia folda walio na ujuzi kidogo au walio na ustadi kidogo wa gari.
hypothesis: Ilianzishwa na John Smith katika miaka ya 1970 kusaidia folda zisizo na uzoefu au wale walio na ujuzi mdogo wa motor.

source: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.
reference: Watoto hukuza ufahamu wa utaifa na kasumba za utaifa wakiwa wangali wachanga na kasumba hizo za utaifa huathiri tabia.
hypothesis: Watoto hujifunza kuhusu jamii na maoni ya watu wa jamii tofauti-tofauti wakiwa wachanga sana na maoni hayo huathiri tabia zao.

source: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.
reference: Kwa mfano, watoto ambao wanashirikishwa na uchache wa kabila wanaodhaniwa kuwa hawafanyi vizuri shuleni huwa hawafanyi vizuri shuleni mara tu wanapogundua juu ya dhana linalohusishwa na kabila zao.
hypothesis: Kwa mfano, watoto ambao wanajiona kuwa sehemu ya jamii ndogo ambayo huonwa kuwa haina mafanikio shuleni, mara nyingi hawafanyi vizuri shuleni wanapojifunza kuhusu maoni hayo yasiyofaa yanayohusiana na jamii yao.

source: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.
reference: MySpace ni tovuti ya tatu kwa umaarufu inayotumika nchini Marekani na ina wasajili milioni 54 sasa hivi.
hypothesis: MySpace ni tovuti ya tatu maarufu zaidi kutumika katika Marekani na ina 54 milioni maelezo ya sasa.

source: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.
reference: Tovuti hizi zimepata umakinifu mwingi sana, hasa katika mpangilio wa kielimu.
hypothesis: Tovuti hizi zimepata uangalifu mwingi, hasa katika mazingira ya elimu.

source: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.
reference: Kuna vipengele chanya kuhusu tovuti hizi, ambazo ni pamoja na, kuwa rahisi kusanidi ukurasa wa darasa ambao unaweza kutia ndani blogu, video, picha, na vipengele vingine.
hypothesis: Kuna mambo mazuri kwenye tovuti hizi, ambazo ni pamoja na, kuwa na uwezo wa kuanzisha ukurasa wa darasa kwa urahisi ambao unaweza kujumuisha blogu, video, picha, na vipengele vingine.

source: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.
reference: Ukurasa huu unaweza kufikiwa kwa urahisi kwa kutoa anwani moja tu ya wavuti, ambayo inaifanya kuwa rahisi kukumbuka na rahisi kuchapa kwa wanafunzi ambao wanaweza kuwa na shida kutumia kibodi au na tahajia.
hypothesis: Ukurasa huu unaweza kupatikana kwa urahisi kwa kutoa anwani moja tu ya mtandao, ambayo inafanya iwe rahisi kukumbuka na rahisi kuandika kwa wanafunzi ambao wanaweza kuwa na shida kutumia keyboard au na herufi.

source: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.
reference: Inaweza kugeuzwa ili iwe rahisi kusoma na pia na rangi nyingi au kidogo kama inavyonuiwa.
hypothesis: Inaweza kuboreshwa ili iwe rahisi kusoma na pia iwe na rangi nyingi au kidogo kama inavyopendwa.

source: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".
reference: Tatizo la Upungufu wa Umakini "ni ugonjwa wa neva ambao dalili zake tatu za kawaida za kuufafanua ni msukumo, mvurugo na utendaji wa kupita kiasi au nguvu za ziada."
hypothesis: Ugonjwa wa Kupoteza Uangalifu "ni ugonjwa wa neva ambao unaonyesha dalili tatu za kawaida, kutia ndani kupoteza uangalifu, kutoweza kuelekeza fikira, na kuwa na shughuli nyingi kupita kiasi au kutumia nishati kupita kiasi".

source: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".
reference: Si ulemavu wa kusoma, ni mvurugiko wa kusoma; “unaathiri asilimia 3 hadi 5 ya watoto wote, pengine takriban watoto milioni 2 wa Marekani”.
hypothesis: Si tatizo la kujifunza, ni tatizo la kujifunza; "huathiri asilimia 3 hadi 5 ya watoto wote, labda watoto milioni 2 wa Marekani".

source: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.
reference: Watoto walio na ADD huwa na wakati mgumu kuangazia mambo kama kazi za shuleni, lakini wanaweza kukazia fikira mambo wanayopenda kuyafanya kama kucheza michezo au kutazama katuni zao vibwedo au kuandika sentensi bila kuakifisha.
hypothesis: Watoto wenye ADD wana wakati mgumu wa kuzingatia mambo kama kazi ya shule, lakini wanaweza kuzingatia mambo wanayopenda kufanya kama kucheza michezo au kutazama katuni zao wanazopenda au kuandika sentensi bila alama za alama.

source: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.
reference: Watoto hawa huingia kwenye shida nyingi kwa sababu “wanajihusisha na tabia hatari, wanaingia kwenye vita na kuipa changamoto mamlaka” ili kuchechemua akili zao kwa sababu akili zao haziwezi kuchechemuliwa kwa njia za kawaida.
hypothesis: Watoto hao huwa na mwelekeo wa kuingia katika matatizo mengi, kwa sababu "wanajihusisha katika tabia zenye hatari, huingia katika mapigano, na kupinga mamlaka" ili kuchochea ubongo wao, kwa kuwa ubongo wao hauwezi kuchochewa kwa njia za kawaida.

source: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.
reference: Ugonjwa wa Upungufu wa Usikivu huathiri uhusiano wao na wenzi wengine kwa sababu watoto wengine hawawezi kuelewa kwa nini wao hujifanya kwa njia hiyo au kwa nini wao huduwaa jinsi wanavyofanya au kwamba kiwango cha kukomaa kwao ni tofauti.
hypothesis: ADD huathiri mahusiano na marika wengine kwa sababu watoto wengine hawawezi kuelewa ni kwa nini wanafanya mambo kwa njia wanayofanya au kwa nini wanaandika maneno kwa njia wanayofanya au kwamba kiwango chao cha ukomavu ni tofauti.

source: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.
reference: Jinsi uwezo wa kupata maarifa na kujifunza ulivyobadilika kwa njia kama ilivyoelezewa hapo juu, ndivyo kiwango msingi ambacho kwacho maarifa yalipatikana kilivyobadilika.
hypothesis: Kama uwezo wa kupata maarifa na kujifunza kubadilika kwa njia kama ilivyotajwa hapo juu kiwango cha msingi ambayo maarifa zilipatikana kubadilika.

source: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.
reference: Njia ya kupata habari ilikuwa tofauti. Shaka haikuwa tena ndani ya kumbukumbu ya mtu binafsi, lakini uwezo wa kukumbuka maandishi ukawa wa kuzingatiwa zaidi.
hypothesis: Mbinu ya kupata taarifa ilikuwa tofauti. hakuna tena shinikizo iko ndani ya kumbukumbu binafsi, lakini uwezo wa kumbukumbu maandishi akawa zaidi ya lengo.

source: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.
reference: Kimsingi, Kipindi cha Mwamko kilifanya mabadiliko muhimu katika mbinu za kujifunza na usambazaji wa maarifa.
hypothesis: Kwa msingi, Enzi ya Ufufuo ilileta mabadiliko makubwa katika njia ya kujifunza na kueneza maarifa.

source: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.
reference: Tofauti na nyani wengine, hominidi hawatumii mikono yao kwa kutembea, kubebea uzito au kubembea kwenye miti.
hypothesis: Tofauti na wanyama wengine wa hali ya juu, hominidi hazitumii tena mikono yao katika kusafiri au kubeba mizigo au kuzunguka-zunguka miti.

source: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.
reference: Mkono na mguu wa sokwe ni sawa kwa ukubwa na urefu, kuonyesha matumizi ya mkono kwa kubeba uzito katika kutembea kwa konzi.
hypothesis: Mkono na mguu wa shimpanzi ni sawa kwa ukubwa na urefu, na hilo linaonyesha jinsi mkono unavyotumiwa kubeba uzito unapotembea kwa mikono.

source: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.
reference: Mkono wa binadamu ni mfupi kuliko mguu, na una mifupa minyoofu zaidi..
hypothesis: Mkono wa mwanadamu ni mfupi kuliko mguu, na una matabaka yaliyonyooka zaidi.

source: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.
reference: Visukuku vya mifupa ya mikono vilivyo na miaka milioni mbili hadi milioni tatu vinafunua haya mabadiliko ya utaalam wa mkono kutoka kwa kuusongesha na kuutumia.
hypothesis: Mifupa ya kale ya mkono yenye umri wa miaka milioni mbili hadi milioni tatu hufunua badiliko hilo katika ustadi wa mkono kutoka kwa utaratibu wa kutembea hadi utaratibu wa kuendesha.

source: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.
reference: Watu wengine wanaamini kuwa kupata ndoto nyingi bandia mara nyingi kunaweza kuchosha sana.
hypothesis: Watu fulani huamini kwamba kuwa na ndoto nyingi za kimuujiza zinazochochewa kisanii mara nyingi vya kutosha kwaweza kuwa jambo lenye kuchosha sana.

source: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.
reference: Sababu kuu ya jambo hili ni matokeo ya ndoto dhahiri kupanua kipindi cha wakati kati ya majimbo ya REM.
