reference: Kampuni za midia daima hudanganya kuhusu madhumuni ya hili, zikidai kwamba ni kwa “kuzuia uharamu”.
hypothesis: Kampuni za vyombo vya habari husema uwongo mara nyingi kuhusu kusudi la kufanya hivyo, wakidai kwamba ni "kuzuia utekaji-nyara".

source: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.
reference: Kwa kweli, misimbo ya mikoa hazina athari kabisa kwa unakilishaji haramu; nakala ndogo ndogo za diski zitacheza tu vizuri kwenye kifaa chochote kinachocheza nakala halisi.
hypothesis: Kwa kweli, nambari za eneo hazina athari yoyote juu ya kunakili kinyume cha sheria; nakala ya disk ya kidogo-kidogo itacheza vizuri kwenye kifaa chochote ambapo ile ya awali itafanya.

source: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.
reference: Lengo halisi ni kuzipatia kampuni hizo udhibiti zaidi wa masoko yake; yote ni kuhusu kutengeneza pesa.
hypothesis: Lengo halisi ni kuwapa makampuni hayo udhibiti zaidi juu ya masoko yao; yote ni kuhusu fedha kuzunguka.

source: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.
reference: Kwa sababu simu hupitishwa kwenye intaneti, huhitaji kutumia kampuni ya simu iliyo mahali unakoishi au unakosafiri.
hypothesis: Kwa kuwa simu hupitishwa kupitia Intaneti, huhitaji kutumia kampuni ya simu inayopatikana katika eneo unaloishi au unaloenda.

source: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.
reference: Pia hakuna sharti kwamba upate nambari ya kienyeji kutoka kwa jamii unakoishi; unaweza kupata unganisho la mtandao wa satelaiti kwenye porini ya Chicken, Alaska na uchague nambari inayodai uko katika Arizona yenye jua.
hypothesis: Pia hakuna takwa la kupata namba ya simu ya eneo unaloishi; unaweza kupata mtandao wa satelaiti katika eneo la Chicken, Alaska na kuchagua namba inayosema uko katika eneo lenye jua la Arizona.

source: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.
reference: Mara nyingi, unafaa kununua kando nambari ya kimataifa ambayo inakubali simu za PSTN kukupigia. Mahali nambari hiyo imetoka huleta tofauti kwa watu wanaokupigia.
hypothesis: Mara nyingi, una kununua namba ya kimataifa tofauti ambayo inaruhusu PSTN simu ya kupiga simu. Ambapo namba ni kutoka ni tofauti kwa watu wanaokuita.

source: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.
reference: Programu za utafsiri wa matini kwa wakati halisi – programu-tumizi ambazo zina uwezo wa kutafsiri sehemu nzima za matini kutoka lugha moja kwa nyingine kiotomatiki.
hypothesis: programu ya muda halisi ya kutafsiri maandishi  programu ambazo ni uwezo wa moja kwa moja kutafsiri sehemu nzima ya maandishi kutoka lugha moja hadi nyingine.

source: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.
reference: Baadhi ya programu-tumizi katika kategoria hii zinaweza hata kutafsiri matini ya lugha za kigeni kwenye vibao vya ishara au vitu vingine katika dunia halisi wakati mtumiaji anapoelekeza simu maizi kwenye vitu hivyo.
hypothesis: Baadhi ya programu katika jamii hii inaweza hata kutafsiri maandiko katika lugha za kigeni juu ya ishara au vitu vingine katika ulimwengu wa kweli wakati mtumiaji inaelekeza smartphone kuelekea vitu hivyo.

source: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.
reference: Injini za utafsiri zimeimarika sana, na sasa mara nyingi hutoa tafsiri inayokaribia usahihi (na kawaida huwa si upuzi), lakini umakini unahitajika, kwani zinaweza kuwa zimekosea kabisa.
hypothesis: Injini za kutafsiri zimeboresha sana, na sasa mara nyingi hutoa tafsiri sahihi zaidi au chini (na mara chache zaidi ni za kijuujuu), lakini tahadhari fulani ni ya lazima, kwa kuwa bado huenda wakawa wamepata makosa yote.

source: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.
reference: Mojawapo ya programu maarufu sana katika kategoria hii ni Google Translate, ambayo huruhusu utafsiri nje ya mtandao baada ya kupakua data ya lugha inayotakikana.
hypothesis: Moja ya programu maarufu katika jamii hii ni Google Translate, ambayo inaruhusu tafsiri nje ya mtandao baada ya kupakua data ya lugha unayotaka.

source: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.
reference: Kutumia programu za kuabiri za GPS kwenye rununu yako kunaweza kuwa njia rahisi na bora ya kuabiri ukiwa nje ya nchi yako.
hypothesis: Kutumia programu za GPS kwenye simu yako ya mkononi kunaweza kuwa njia rahisi na rahisi zaidi ya kuelekeza habari unapokuwa nje ya nchi yako.

source: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.
reference: Inaweza kuokoa pesa badala ya kununua ramani mpya za GPS, au kifaa cha GPS kinachojisimamia au kukodisha kimoja kutoka kwa kampuni ya kukodisha magari.
hypothesis: Inaweza kuokoa fedha juu ya kununua ramani mpya kwa ajili ya GPS, au kifaa cha GPS cha kujitegemea au kukodisha moja kutoka kampuni ya kukodisha magari.

source: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.
reference: Ikiwa huna muunganisho wa data kwa simu yako, au ikiwa mbali na masafa, utendakazi wake utakwazika au hautakuwepo.
hypothesis: Kama huna uhusiano data kwa ajili ya simu yako, au wakati ni nje ya mbalimbali, utendaji wao inaweza kuwa mdogo au haipatikani.

source: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.
reference: Kila duka la karibu limejawa na aina nyingi za kukanganya za kadi za simu za kulipia kabla ambazo zinaweza kutumika katika simu za kulipia au simu za kawaida.
hypothesis: Kila duka la kona lina kadi za simu za kulipia ambazo zinaweza kutumiwa kutoka kwenye simu za umma au za kawaida.

source: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.
reference: Huku kadi nyingi zikiwa nzuri kwa kupiga simu kila mahali, nyingine ni maalumu kwa kutoa gharama za chini za kupiga simu kwa vikundi mahususi vya mataifa.
hypothesis: Ingawa kadi nyingi zinafaa kupiga simu popote, nyingine hutoa viwango vya simu kwa vikundi maalum vya nchi.

source: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.
reference: Ufikiaji wa huduma hizi mara nyingi ni kupitia nambari ya simu isiyolipishwa ambayo inaweza kupigwa kutoka simu nyingi bila malipo.
hypothesis: Mara nyingi, watu wanaweza kupata huduma hizo kupitia namba ya simu ya bure ambayo inaweza kuitwa bila malipo kutoka kwenye simu nyingi.

source: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.
reference: Kanuni kuhusu upigaji picha za kawaida pia hutumika kwa kurekodi video, pengine hata zaidi.
hypothesis: Sheria kuhusu kupiga picha kwa kawaida zinatumika pia kwa kurekodi video, labda hata zaidi.

source: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.
reference: Ikiwa kupiga picha ya kitu tu hakuruhusiwi, basi hupaswi hata kufikiria kurekodi video yake.
hypothesis: Kama kupiga picha ya kitu hakuruhusiwi, basi usiweze hata kufikiria kurekodi video ya kitu hicho.

source: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.
reference: Ikiwa unatumia ndege-roboti, angalia mapema ni nini unachoruhusiwa kuchukua filamu yake na ni vibali au leseni gani za ziada zinazohitajika.
hypothesis: Ikiwa unatumia ndege isiyo na kifaa cha kubebea picha, chunguza mapema mambo ambayo unaruhusiwa kupiga picha na ni ruhusa gani au leseni zipi za ziada zinahitajika.

source: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.
reference: Kurusha kidege-roboti karibu na uwanja wa ndege juu ya umati wa watu ni wazo mbaya karibu kila wakati, hata kama si haramu katika eneo lako.
hypothesis: Kuruka kwa ndege karibu na uwanja wa ndege au juu ya umati wa watu ni wazo baya mara nyingi, hata ikiwa si kinyume cha sheria katika eneo lenu.

source: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.
reference: Siku hizi usafiri wa ndege huhifadhiwa moja kwa moja mara chache kupitia kampuni ya ndege bila kwanza kutafuta na kulinganisha bei.
hypothesis: Leo ni mara chache tu kusafiri kwa ndege ni booked moja kwa moja kupitia kampuni ya ndege bila kwanza kutafuta na kulinganisha bei.

source: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.
reference: Wakati mwingine safari moja inaweza kuwa na bei zinazotofautiana sana katika wajumuishaji tofauti na ina faida kulinganisha matokeo ya utafutaji na pia kuangalia tovuti ya kampuni ya ndege yenyewe kabla ya kuhifadhi.
hypothesis: Wakati mwingine ndege hiyo inaweza kuwa na bei tofauti sana katika aggregators mbalimbali na ni kulipa kulinganisha matokeo ya utafutaji na pia kuangalia tovuti ya ndege mwenyewe kabla ya kuweka nafasi.

source: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.
reference: Wakati huenda usihitaji visa kwa ziara fupi katika nchi fulani kama mtalii au kwa biashara, kwenda huko kama mwanafunzi wa kimataifa kwa jumla kunahitaji kukaa kwa muda mrefu kuliko kwenda huko kama mtalii wa kawaida tu.
hypothesis: Ingawa huenda usihitaji viza ya ziara fupi katika nchi fulani ukiwa mtalii au kwa sababu za biashara, kwenda huko ukiwa mwanafunzi wa kimataifa kwa kawaida huhitaji kukaa muda mrefu kuliko kwenda huko ukiwa mtalii wa kawaida tu.

source: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.
reference: Kwa ujumla, kukaa kwenye nchi ya kigeni kwa muda mrefu zaidi kunahitaji upate visa mapema.
hypothesis: Kwa ujumla, kukaa katika nchi yoyote ya kigeni kwa muda mrefu kutakuhitaji kupata visa mapema.

source: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.
reference: Kwa jumla visa za wanafunzi huwa na mahitaji na utaratibu wa maombi tofauti na visa za kawaida za kitalii au kibiashara.
hypothesis: Visa vya wanafunzi kwa ujumla vina mahitaji na taratibu tofauti za maombi kuliko visa vya kawaida vya utalii au biashara.

source: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.
reference: Kwa nchi nyingi, utahitaji barua ya ofa kutoka kwa taasisi ambayo unataka kusomea, na pia ushahidi wa pesa za kujisaidia kwa angalau mwaka wa kwanza wa kozi yako.
hypothesis: Kwa nchi nyingi, utahitaji barua ya kutoa kutoka taasisi unataka kusoma, na pia uthibitisho wa fedha ili kujitegemeza mwenyewe kwa angalau mwaka wa kwanza wa kozi yako.

source: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.
reference: Angalia katika taasisi, vilevile idara ya uhamiaji ya nchi ambako unahitaji kusomea kwa mahitaji ya kina.
hypothesis: Tafadhali wasiliana na taasisi, pamoja na idara ya uhamiaji ya nchi unayotaka kusoma kwa mahitaji ya kina.

source: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.
reference: Isipokuwa kama wewe ni mwanadiplomasia, kufanya kazi ughaibuni kwa jumla humaanisha kwamba utalazimika kufaili ushuru wa mapato nchini uliko.
hypothesis: Isipokuwa kama wewe ni mwanadiplomasia, kufanya kazi nje ya nchi kwa ujumla humaanisha kwamba utalazimika kutoa kodi ya mapato katika nchi unayoishi.

source: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.
reference: Ushuru wa mapato huundwa kwa njia tofauti katika nchi tofauti, na viwango na vikundi vya ushuru hutofautiana pakubwa toka nchi moja hadi nyingine.
hypothesis: Kodi ya mapato imepangwa tofauti katika nchi mbalimbali, na viwango vya kodi na vikwazo vya kodi hutofautiana sana kutoka nchi moja hadi nyingine.

source: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.
reference: Katika baadhi ya nchi za shirikisho, kama vile Marekani na Kanada, ushuru wa mapato hutozwa katika ngazi ya shirikisho na pia ngazi ya ndani, kwa hivyo viwango na vikundi vinaweza kutofautiana toka eneo hadi eneo.
hypothesis: Katika nchi fulani za shirikisho, kama vile Marekani na Kanada, kodi ya mapato hulipwa katika nchi za shirikisho na za mitaa, kwa hiyo viwango na vikwazo vya kodi ya mapato vinaweza kutofautiana kutoka eneo moja hadi jingine.

source: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.
reference: Wakati kuangaliwa kwa uhamiaji kawaida haupo au ni urasmi ukifika katika nchi yako, udhibiti wa forodha unaweza kuwa shida.
hypothesis: Ingawa mara nyingi hakupatikani ukaguzi wa uhamiaji au ni jambo la kawaida unapofika nyumbani, ukaguzi wa forodha unaweza kuwa mgumu.

source: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.
reference: Hakikisha unajua kile unachoweza na hauwezi kuleta kisha kutangaza kitu chochote juu ya mipaka ya kisheria.
hypothesis: Hakikisha unajua nini unaweza na huwezi kuleta na tangaza chochote zaidi ya mipaka ya kisheria.

source: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.
reference: Njia ilio rahisi kuanza biashara ya uandishi wa usafiri ni kuonyeshana ujuzi wako kwenye tovuti ya blogu ya usafiri iliyo imara.
hypothesis: Njia rahisi ya kuanza katika biashara ya kuandika safari ni kuboresha ujuzi wako kwenye tovuti ya blogu ya kusafiri iliyoanzishwa.

source: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.
reference: Unaporidhika na umbizo na uhariri kwenye wavuti, basi baadaye, labda utaunda tovuti yako mwenyewe.
hypothesis: Baada ya kuwa na starehe na formating na kuhariri kwenye mtandao, basi baadaye, unaweza kujenga tovuti yako mwenyewe.

source: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.
reference: Kujitolea wakati wa kusafiri ni njia nzuri ya kuleta mabadiliko lakini si kuhusu utoaji tu.
hypothesis: Kujitolea wakati wa kusafiri ni njia nzuri ya kubadilisha mambo lakini sio tu kuhusu kutoa.

source: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.
reference: Kuishi na kujitolea katika nchi ya kigeni ni njia bora ya kupata kujua utamaduni mpya, kukutana na watu wapya, kujifunza juu yako mwenyewe, kupata hisia za mtazamo na hata kupata ujuzi mpya.
hypothesis: Kuishi na kufanya kazi ya kujitolea katika nchi ya kigeni ni njia nzuri ya kupata kujua utamaduni tofauti, kukutana na watu wapya, kujifunza kuhusu wewe mwenyewe, kupata hisia ya mtazamo na hata kupata ujuzi mpya.

source: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.
reference: Pia inaweza kuwa njia bora ya kupanua bajeti ili kuwezesha kukaa mahali kwa muda mrefu kwani kazi nyingi za kujitolea hutoa vyumba na malazi na baadhi hulipa mshahara kidogo.
hypothesis: Pia inaweza kuwa njia nzuri ya kuongeza bajeti ili kuruhusu kukaa muda mrefu mahali fulani kwa kuwa kazi nyingi za kujitolea hutoa makao na chakula na wachache hulipa mshahara mdogo.

source: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.
reference: Maharamia wa Skandinavia walitumia njia za majini za Kirusi kufika kwenye Bahari Nyeusi na Bahari ya Kaspi. Sehemu za njia hizo bado zinaweza kutumika. Angalia uwezekano wa kuhitaji vibali maalum, ambavyo huenda ikawa vigumu kuvipata.
hypothesis: Vikings kutumika maji ya Urusi kupata Bahari Nyeusi na Bahari ya Kaspi. Sehemu ya njia hizi bado inaweza kutumika. Angalia uwezekano wa haja ya ruhusa maalum, ambayo inaweza kuwa vigumu kupata.

source: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.
reference: Mfereji kati ya Bahari Nyeupe na Baltic huunganisha Bahari kuu ya Atiki na Bahari ya Baltic, kupitia Ziwa Onega, Ziwa Ladoga na Saint Petersburg, mara nyingi kwa mito na maziwa.
hypothesis: Bahari ya WhiteBaltic Canal inaunganisha Bahari ya Arctic na Bahari ya Baltic, kupitia Ziwa Onega, Ziwa Ladoga na St Petersburg, zaidi ya yote kwa mito na maziwa.

source: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.
reference: Ziwa Onega limeunganishwa na Volga, kwa hivyo bado inawezekana kusafiri kutoka Bahari Caspian kupitia Urusi.
hypothesis: Ziwa Onega pia lina uhusiano na Volga, hivyo bado inawezekana kutoka Bahari ya Kaspi kupitia Urusi.

source: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.
reference: Kuwa na uhakika ya kwamba unapofika bandarini, kila kitu kitakuwa dhahiri. Utapatana na waombajilifti wa machua wengine na watashiriki habari nawewe.
hypothesis: Kuwa na uhakika kwamba mara moja wewe hit marinas kila kitu itakuwa pretty dhahiri. wewe kukutana na wengine boti hitchhikers na wao kushiriki habari zao na wewe.

source: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.
reference: Kimsingi utakuwa unaweka matangazo kuhusu msaada wako, kutembea katika gati, kuongelesha watu wanaosafisha mashua zao, kujaribu kuwasiliana na mabaharia kwenye baa, na kadhalika.
hypothesis: Kwa msingi utakuwa kuweka matangazo kutoa msaada wako, kutembea kwenye bandari, kukaribia watu kusafisha yachts yao, kujaribu kufanya mawasiliano na mabaharia katika bar, nk.

source: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.
reference: Jaribu kuongea na watu wengi iwezekanavyo. Baada ya muda mfupi kila mtu atakujua na watakutolea vidokezo kuhusu ni boti ipi inayotafuta mtu.
hypothesis: Jaribu kuzungumza na watu wengi iwezekanavyo. Baada ya muda wote watakutambua na kukupa vidokezo juu ya mashua ipi inatafuta mtu.

source: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.
reference: Unafaa kuchagua kampuni ya Usafiri wa Mara Nyingi katika muungano kwa makini.
hypothesis: Unapaswa kuchagua ndege yako Frequent Flyer katika muungano kwa makini.

source: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.
reference: Ingawa unaweza kudhani ni bora zaidi kujiunga na kampuni ya ndege unayotumia zaidi, unapaswa kujua kuwa marupurupu yanayotolewa mara nyingi ni tofauti na pointi za usafiri wa mara kwa mara huenda zikawa karimu zaidi chini ya kampuni tofauti katika muungano mmoja.
hypothesis: Ingawa huenda ukafikiri ni jambo la kawaida kujiunga na kampuni ya ndege unayosafiri kwa ukawaida, unapaswa kujua kwamba mara nyingi mapendeleo yanayotolewa hutofautiana na kwamba watu wanaosafiri kwa ukawaida wanaweza kupata mapato mengi zaidi chini ya kampuni ya ndege tofauti katika muungano huohuo.

source: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.
reference: Kampuni za ndege kama vile Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways na Turkish Airlines zimepanua huduma zao pakubwa katika Afrika, na hutoa miunganisho kwenye miji mingi muhimu ya Afrika kwa bei bora kuliko kampuni nyingine za Uingereza.
hypothesis: Mashirika ya ndege kama Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines yamepanua huduma zao kwa Afrika, na hutoa uhusiano na miji mingi mikubwa ya Afrika kwa bei za ushindani kuliko mashirika mengine ya ndege ya Ulaya.

source: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.
reference: Shirika la ndege la Uturuki hupaa angani kwenda kwa vituo 39 katika nchi 30 za Kiafrika kuanzia mwaka wa 2014.
hypothesis: Turkish Airlines husafiri kwa njia ya ndege kwenda maeneo 39 katika nchi 30 za Afrika kuanzia mwaka 2014.

source: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.
reference: Ikiwa unao wakati wa ziada wa kusafiri, angalia uone jinsi ankarakifani yako ya jumla ya nauli kwenda Afrika inalingana na nauli ya kuuzunguka ulimwengu.
hypothesis: Ikiwa una muda wa ziada wa kusafiri, angalia jinsi jumla ya bei ya safari yako kwenda Afrika inavyolingana na bei ya safari ya kuzunguka ulimwengu.

source: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.
reference: Usisahau kuongeza gharama za ziada za visa za ziada, ushuru wa kuondoka, usafiri kwenye ardhi, n.k., kwa sehemu hizo zote nje ya Afrika.
hypothesis: Usisahau kuongeza gharama za ziada za visa za ziada, kodi za kuondoka, usafirishaji wa ardhi, nk kwa maeneo yote nje ya Afrika.

source: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.
reference: Ikiwa unataka kusafiri kuzunguka ulimwengu katika Kizio cha Kusini, machaguo ya ndege na mahali si mengi kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa ndege zinazosafiri kuvuka bahari.
hypothesis: Ikiwa unataka kusafiri kuzunguka ulimwengu katika Kizio cha Kusini, uchaguzi wa ndege na marudio ni mdogo kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa njia za bahari.

source: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).
reference: Hakuna muungano wa ndege unaohudumia vivukio vyote vitatu vya bahari katika Ulimwengu wa Kusini (na hakuna kivukio ambacho SkyTeam inahudumia).
hypothesis: Hakuna muungano wa ndege inashughulikia kila tatu bahari kuvuka katika Nusu ya Kusini (na SkyTeam inashughulikia hakuna ya kuvuka).

source: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.
reference: Hata hivyo, Star Alliance hushughulikia kila kitu isipokuwa South Pacific ya mashariki kutoka Santiago de Chile kwenda Tahiti, ambayo ni safari ya LATAM Oneworld.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, Star Alliance inashughulikia kila kitu isipokuwa mashariki ya Pasifiki Kusini kutoka Santiago de Chile hadi Tahiti, ambayo ni ndege ya LATAM Oneworld.

source: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)
reference: Safari hii ya ndege siyo chaguo la pekee kama unataka kuruka Pasifiki Kusini na pwani ya magharibi ya Marekani Kusini. (tazama chini)
hypothesis: Ndege hii si chaguo pekee kama unataka skip Pacific Kusini na pwani ya magharibi ya Amerika ya Kusini. (tazama chini)

source: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.
reference: Mnamo 1994, eneo la Azabaijan lililo la Nagorno-Karabakh kikabila lilifanya vita dhidi ya Azeris.
hypothesis: Mwaka wa 1994, eneo la Nagorno-Karabakh, ambalo ni eneo la jamii ya Waarmenia nchini Azerbaijan, lilipigana na Waazeri.

source: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.
reference: Kwa kuungwa mkono na Armenia, jamhuri mpya iliundwa. Hata hivyo, hakuna nchi thabiti - si hata Armenia - huitambua kirasmi.
hypothesis: Jamhuri mpya ilianzishwa kwa msaada wa Armenia, lakini hakuna taifa lolote linaloitambua rasmi, hata Armenia.

source: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.
reference: Hoja za kidiplomasia dhidi ya eneo hilo zinaendelea kutatiza uhusiano kati ya Armenia na Azerbaian.
hypothesis: Mabishano ya kidiplomasia kuhusu eneo hilo yanaendelea kuharibu uhusiano kati ya Armenia na Azerbaijan.

source: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.
reference: Wilaya ya Canal (Kiholanzi: Grachtengordel) ni wilaya maarufu ya karne ya 17 inayozunguka Binnenstad ya Amsterdam.
hypothesis: Wilaya ya Canal (Kiholanzi: Grachtengordel) ni wilaya maarufu ya karne ya 17 inayozunguka Binnenstad ya Amsterdam.

source: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.
reference: Wilaya nzima imeteuliwa kama Pahali pa Urithi wa Shirika la Umoja wa Mataifa la Elimu, Sayansi na Utamaduni kwa thamani yake ya kipekee ya kitamaduni na kihistoria, na thamani yake ya mali ni kati ya zile za juu zaidi ya nchi.
hypothesis: Wilaya nzima imewekwa kwenye orodha ya Urithi wa Dunia wa UNESCO kwa sababu ya thamani yake ya kipekee ya kitamaduni na kihistoria, na mali zake ni kati ya za juu zaidi nchini.

source: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.
reference: Cinque Terre, yaani Ardhi Tano, ina vijiji vitano vya kipwani vya Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza na Monterosso vilivyo katika eneo la Kiitaliano la Liguria.
hypothesis: Cinque Terre, ambayo inamaanisha Nchi Tano, inajumuisha vijiji vitano vidogo vya pwani vya Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza na Monterosso vilivyo katika mkoa wa Italia wa Liguria.

source: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
reference: Wameorodheshwa katika Orodha ya Urithi wa Dunia ya UNESCO.
hypothesis: Zimeorodheshwa kwenye Orodha ya Urithi wa Dunia ya UNESCO.

source: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.
reference: Kwa karne nyingi, watu walijenga matuta kwa umakini katika mandhari yenye mawemawe na mwinuko hadi kwenye majabali yaliyo juu ya bahari.
hypothesis: Kwa karne nyingi, watu wamejenga kwa uangalifu majengo ya kifahari kwenye mandhari hiyo yenye miamba na yenye matuta, hadi kwenye miamba inayoelekea baharini.

source: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.
reference: Sehemu ya haiba yake ni ukosefu wa maendeleo ya shirika yanayoonekana. Njia, treni na maboti huunganisha vijiji, na magari hayawezi kuvifikia kutoka nje.
hypothesis: Sehemu ya charm yake ni ukosefu wa maendeleo ya kampuni inayoonekana. njia, treni na boti kuunganisha vijiji, na magari hawawezi kufikia yao kutoka nje.

source: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.
reference: Aina za Kifaransa zinazozungumzwa katika Ubelgiji na Uswizi zinatofautiana kidogo na Kifaransa kinachozungumzwa Ufaransa, ingawa zinalingana kiasi cha kueleweka baina yazo.
hypothesis: Aina za Kifaransa zinazozungumzwa Ubelgiji na Uswisi hutofautiana kidogo na Kifaransa kinachozungumzwa Ufaransa, ingawa zinafanana vya kutosha kueleweka.

source: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.
reference: Hasa, mfumo wa hesabu katika Ubelgiji na Uswizi zinazozungumza Kifaransa una mambo yasiyo ya kawaida ambayo ni tofauti na Kifaransa kinachozungumzwa Ufaransa, na matamshi ya maneno kadhaa ni tofauti kidogo.
hypothesis: Hasa, mfumo wa nambari katika lugha ya Kifaransa Ubelgiji na Uswisi ina baadhi ya peculiarities kidogo ambayo ni tofauti na Kifaransa aliyesema katika Ufaransa, na matamshi ya maneno fulani ni tofauti kidogo.

source: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.
reference: Walakini, Wabelgiji wote waliozungumza Kifaransa na Kiswisi walijifunza Kifaransa shuleni, kwa hivyo wangeweza kukuelewa hata ukitumia mfumo wa nambari wa Kifaransa.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, Wabelgiji na Waswisi wote wanaozungumza Kifaransa wangejifunza Kifaransa cha kawaida shuleni, kwa hiyo wangeweza kukuelewa hata kama ungetumia nambari za Kifaransa za kawaida.

source: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."
reference: Katika sehemu nyingi za dunia, kupunga mkono ni ishara ya kirafiki, kuashiria "hujambo."
hypothesis: Katika sehemu nyingi za ulimwengu, kupiga mikono ni ishara ya urafiki, kuonyesha "salamu".

source: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.
reference: Walakini, huko Malaysia, angalau kati ya Malay katika maeneo ya vijijini, inamaanisha "kuja huku," sawa na kidole cha kwanza kilichoelekezwa kuelekea kwenye mwili, ishara ambayo hutumiwa katika nchi fulani za Magharibi, na inapaswa kutumiwa tu kwa sababu hiyo.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, nchini Malaysia, angalau miongoni mwa Wamalaya wa vijijini, inamaanisha "kuja", sawa na kidole cha kuashiria kilichopindika kuelekea mwili, ishara ambayo hutumiwa katika nchi fulani za Magharibi, na inapaswa kutumiwa kwa kusudi hilo tu.

source: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.
reference: Vivyo hivyo, msafiri wa Uingereza huko Uhispania anaweza kukosea kuagana kwaheri kwa kupepa kuhusisha viguzo akikabilia mpepapi (badala ya mtu anayepepewa) kama ishara ya kurudi.
hypothesis: Vivyo hivyo, msafiri Mwingereza anayeenda Hispania anaweza kukosea ishara ya kumsalimu mtu kwa kumshika mkono (na si kumshika mkono) kwa sababu ya ishara ya kurudi.

source: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.
reference: Lugha saidizi ni lugha bandia au za kubuniwa zinazoundwa kwa lengo la kusaidia mawasiliano kati ya watu ambao vinginevyo wangepata shida ya kuwasiliana.
hypothesis: Lugha za ziada ni lugha za bandia au za kubuniwa zilizoundwa kwa kusudi la kuwezesha mawasiliano kati ya watu ambao vinginevyo wangepata ugumu wa kuwasiliana.

source: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.
reference: Wao ni tofauti na lingua Francas, ambayo ni lugha asilia au ya kikaboni ambazo huwa maarufu kwa sababu moja au nyingine kama njia ya mawasiliano kati ya wasemaji wa lugha nyingine.
hypothesis: Wao ni tofauti na lingua francas, ambayo ni lugha za asili au za kikaboni ambazo huwa na nguvu kwa sababu moja au nyingine kama njia ya mawasiliano kati ya wasemaji wa lugha nyingine.

source: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).
reference: Katika joto la siku, wasafiri wanaweza kuona mazigazi ambayo hutoa dhana ya maji (au vitu vingine).
hypothesis: Wakati wa joto la mchana, wasafiri wanaweza kuona maono ya maono yanayofanya wafikiri kwamba kuna maji (au vitu vingine).

source: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.
reference: Hizi zinaweza kuwa hatari ikiwa msafiri atafuata mazigazi, kupoteza nishati ya thamani na maji iliyobaki.
hypothesis: Vitu hivyo vinaweza kuwa hatari ikiwa msafiri atafuatilia kivuli hicho, na hivyo kupoteza nishati na maji ya thamani.

source: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.
reference: Hata jangwa lililo na joto zaidi linaweza likawa baridi sana usiku. Hipothemia ni hatari halisi bila mavazi ya joto.
hypothesis: Hata jangwa lenye joto sana linaweza kuwa baridi sana usiku.

source: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.
reference: Katika kiangazi, hasa, utahitaji kujihadhari na mbu ukiamua kutembea katika msitu wa mvua.
hypothesis: Hasa wakati wa kiangazi, utahitaji kuwa mwangalifu na mbu ukiamua kutembea kupitia msitu wa mvua.

source: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.
reference: Hata ikiwa unaendesha kupitia msitu wa mvua wa kitropiki ndogo, sekunde chache milango ikiwa wazi unapoingia kwenye gari ni muda unaotosha kwa mbu kuingia na wewe garini.
hypothesis: Hata kama unaendesha gari kupitia msitu wa mvua, sekunde chache na milango imefunguliwa wakati unapoingia ndani ya gari ni muda wa kutosha kwa mbu kuingia ndani ya gari pamoja nawe.

source: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.
reference: Homa ya ndege inaweza kuambukiza ndege na pia mamalia.
hypothesis: Homa ya ndege, au kwa ufupi zaidi homa ya ndege, yaweza kuambukiza ndege na wanyama wanaonyonya.

source: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.
reference: Kesi chache chini ya elfu zimewahi kuripotiwa kwa wanadamu, lakini baadhi yazo zilipelekea kifo.
hypothesis: Watu wasiozidi elfu moja wamepatwa na ugonjwa huo, lakini baadhi yao wamekufa.

source: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.
reference: Mengi yamehusisha watu ambao hufanya kazi na kuku, lakini pia kuna hatari kiasi kwa watazama ndege.
hypothesis: Wengi wao wamehusisha watu wanaofanya kazi na kuku, lakini kuna hatari fulani kwa watazamaji wa ndege.

source: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.
reference: Kawaida kwa Norwei kuwa na vilango-bahari vyenye miinuko mikali na mabonde ambayo ghafla hugeuka kuwa kilima kirefu tambarare ambacho ni bapa, kwa kadiri fulani.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida, Norway ina vilima na mabonde yaliyoinuka ambayo hujitokeza kwa ghafula na kuwa nyanda za juu, au hata za juu.

source: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.
reference: Nyanda hizi za juu mara nyingi huitwa "vidde" kumaanisha nafasi pana, wazi isiyo na miti, eneo lisilo na mipaka.
hypothesis: Mara nyingi nyanda hizo huitwa "vidde" ikimaanisha mahali pana, pasipo na miti, mahali pasipo na mipaka.

source: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.
reference: Katika Rogaland na Agder kwa kawaida huitwa "hei" kumaanisha ardhi iliyotengwa isiyo na miti na mara nyingi hufunikwa na mimea ya vichakani.
hypothesis: Katika Rogaland na Agder wao kwa kawaida kuitwa "hei" maana moorland bila miti mara nyingi kufunikwa na heather.

source: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.
reference: Mabarafuto si imara, lakini yanatiririka kuenda chini ya mlima. Hii itasababisha nyufa, mianya, ambayo inaweza kufichwa na madaraja ya theluji.
hypothesis: Barafu si imara, lakini mtiririko chini mlima. Hii itasababisha mipasuko, nyufa, ambayo inaweza kuwa obscured na madaraja theluji.

source: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.
reference: Kuta na paa za mapango ya barafu zinaweza kuporomoka na nyufa zinaweza kuzibwa.
hypothesis: Kuta na paa za pango la barafu zinaweza kuanguka na nyufa zinaweza kufungwa.

source: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.
reference: Kwenye ukingo wa barafuto vipande vikubwa hujitenga, kuanguka na pengine kuruka au kubingirika mbali zaidi na ukingo.
hypothesis: Kwenye kingo za barafu, vipande vikubwa vya barafu huanguka, huanguka, na labda kuruka au kuanguka mbali zaidi na kingo.

source: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.
reference: Msimu wa watalii kwa vituo vya vilimani kwa jumla hupata shughuli nyingi wakati wa kiangazi cha Kihindi.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida, msimu wa watalii katika maeneo ya milima huwa na kilele wakati wa kiangazi cha India.

source: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.
reference: Hata hivyo, vina urembo na haiba ya aina fulani wakati wa msimu wa baridi, na vituo vingi vya vilima hupata viwango vya kutosha vya theluji na kutoa shughuli kama utelezaji na utelezaji kwa vibao.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, wakati wa majira ya baridi, maeneo hayo huwa na uzuri na kuvutia kwa sababu yana theluji nyingi na pia yana shughuli kama vile kuteleza kwenye theluji na kuteleza kwenye theluji.

source: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.
reference: Ni mashirika machache tu ya ndege ambayo bado hutoa nauli ya kufiwa, ambayo hupunguza kidogo gharama ya kusafiri kwa mazishi dakika ya mwisho.
hypothesis: Ni ndege chache tu ambazo bado hutoa tikiti za watu waliofiwa, ambazo hupunguza kidogo gharama ya safari ya dakika ya mwisho ya kwenda kwenye mazishi.

source: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.
reference: Ndege zinazotoa hizi ni pamoja na Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa kwa ndege zinazotoka Marekani au Kanada, na WestJet.
hypothesis: Mashirika ya ndege ambayo hutoa hizi ni pamoja na Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa kwa ndege zinazotoka Marekani au Canada, na WestJet.

source: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
reference: Katika visa vyote, lazima ujitengee nafasi mapema kwa kupiga simu moja kwa moja kwenye shirika la ndege.
hypothesis: Katika kesi zote, lazima uweke simu moja kwa moja na kampuni ya ndege.
